characters.title: Telence T. D'Arby
characters.name_ja: テレンス・T.・ダービー
characters.bio: Telence T. D'Arby is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "D'Arby the Player" story arc.
characters.background: Telence T. D'Arby was born on January 5, 1968. He grew up alongside his brother Daniel J. D'Arby.
characters.personality: As a butler, Telence is a mannerly individual. However, his demeanor is a facade for his twisted and arrogant personality.
characters.ja_kanji: テレンス・T.・ダービー

characters.title: Mariah
characters.bio: Mariah is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "'Bastet' Mariah" story arc. She also appears as a tertiary character in the spin-off manga Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak and the light novel Crazy Heartbreakers.
characters.personality: Mariah comes off as a calm, cool-headed person. Like most Stand users, Mariah has great confidence in her Bastet, notably in that everyone will eventually succumb to it given time. However, she easily loses her cool whenever things don't go according to plan; in such cases, she's been shown to contort her face and bite her lip comically out of frustration and anger.

characters.title: Vanilla Ice
characters.bio: Vanilla Ice is a primary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically in the "The Miasma of the Void, Vanilla Ice" story arc.
characters.personality: Vanilla Ice is most notable for his disturbing, unwavering loyalty to DIO, whom he believes to be above all others. He is willing to go as far as to decapitate himself to give DIO blood, which inspires admiration from DIO for the extent of his servitude. Even when on the brink of death, he remains in thrall to DIO and exclaims that he will not let himself die so long as Joseph and his companions are still alive. Although normally cool-headed and calculated, his devotion is great enough to send him into an outrage over being forced to attack a mere likeness of DIO created by The Fool. characters.title: Mannish Boy
characters.bio: Mannish Boy is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "Death Thirteen" story arc.
characters.personality: Mannish Boy is an impossible genius: although he is a baby, he thinks and behaves much older. In public, Mannish Boy hides his true self and acts like an ordinary baby to throw people off.

characters.title: N'Doul
characters.bio: N'Doul is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the ""The Fool" Iggy and "Geb" N'Doul" story arc.
characters.background: N'Doul was a blind man who, thanks to his Stand, never feared anything in his entire life, not even death. It allowed him to do anything he wanted and get away with it without consequences, as even the police wouldn't find out about his crimes, although no one ever saw his true value. One day, he encountered DIO and was charmed by his charisma, DIO being the only person to see his true value. N'Doul started to admire that man so much he saw him as his savior, later claiming that "even evil needs a savior".
characters.personality: N'Doul's strongest trait is his loyalty to DIO and determined focus to carry out his will. He battles the Crusaders relentlessly and even goes as far as to fatally injure himself to escape questioning. N'Doul fanatically idolizes DIO fully knowing his evil, stating that people like him deserve a savior.

characters.title: Midler
characters.bio: Midler is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "High Priestess" story arc.
characters.background: Midler is a Stand User hired by DIO to kill the Joestar Group on their way to Egypt. Similar to other hired help like Devo the Cursed, she has a notable underground reputation as an assassin, as Muhammad Avdol was not only able to identify her, but also describe her Stand's ability and characteristics. Prior to engaging the crusaders, Midler had High Priestess travel through the water and enter their submarine through a hole in the wall.
characters.personality: Midler is a ruthless mercenary of DIO who does not hesitate to kill the Joestar Group with High Priestess, both sinking their submarine and attempting to kill them directly with her Stand. She tends to laugh when she injures any of them. She is clever with her Stand, nearly killing both Polnareff and Jotaro.

characters.title: Pet Shop
characters.bio: Pet Shop is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "The Gatekeeper of Hell, Pet Shop" story arc. Pet Shop also appears as a posthumous tertiary antagonist in the spin-off manga Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak and the light novel Crazy Heartbreakers.
characters.background: In Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak, it is explained that Pet Shop was raised and trained by a bird trainer, who trained the falcon alongside a parrot. After attempting to escape from DIO's grasp, he was murdered.
characters.personality: A ruthless sentry who is loyal to his post, Pet Shop almost always bears a menacing glare and does not discriminate against any who trespasses DIO's mansion. He intended to kill a small boy and would have if it wasn't for Iggy's interference, and showed no remorse in eating the eyes of two dogs he decapitated in front of their owner. He is extremely relentless in hunting down his prey, as shown by his pursuit of Iggy, no matter how risky the path to his prey might be. He is also highly intelligent, having identified the beggar employed by Avdol as a spy and tearing up the photograph of the mansion after killing him to destroy his work.

characters.title: Cameo
characters.bio: Cameo is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "Judgement" story arc.
characters.personality: Cameo is a cruel man who pretends to be a genie using his Stand, Judgement. He initially takes on the guise of a grateful genie and is lenient, allowing Polnareff to confirm if he wants to make a wish Cameo deems boring and even cancel a wish after confirming it.

characters.title: Oingo
characters.bio: Oingo is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the ""Khnum" Oingo and "Tohth" Boingo" story arc.
characters.personality: Like all of DIO's servants, Oingo is an evil character, although in a more petty way than most. He is an assassin and thus has no problem trying to murder the heroes. In a lighter way, Oingo is also petty enough to pick on people weaker than himself; when he is frustrated that an assassination attempt went wrong, he punches a random man on the street whose face happens to anger him and happily takes his fallen wallet with him.

characters.title: Daniel J. D'Arby
characters.name_ja: ダニエル・J・ダービー
characters.bio: Daniel J. D'Arby is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "D'Arby the Gambler" story arc.
characters.background: Daniel J. D'Arby was born around 1958 and grew up alongside his brother Telence T. D'Arby.
characters.personality:
Daniel J. D'Arby exhibits an affable but sly, knowing character.
D'Arby first and foremost character trait is his love of gambling. He states that he lives for the thrill of gambling (which he recognizes as worthless). This love of gambling is complemented by his enjoyment for cheating, and he proudly admits that cheating is one of his greatest skills, shamelessly rigging every game he's seen participating to while justifying himself by claiming that if the cheat isn't exposed, it is "fair" game.
characters.ja_kanji: ダニエル・J・ダービー

characters.title: Alessi
characters.bio: Alessi is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "'Sethan' Alessi" story arc.
characters.personality: Alessi is a sadistic yet cowardly man who will only fight those who are weaker than him. He takes extreme pleasure in taunting and humiliating his opponents before finishing them off, and will exploit any underhanded method to gain an unfair advantage.

characters.title: Kenny G.
characters.bio: Kenny G. is a tertiary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders.
characters.background: Kenny G. is first shown preparing himself to battle the Joestar group with Vanilla Ice and Telence T. D'Arby. When Nukesaku suggests he could help them, the group threatens to kill him should he interfere in their battle.
characters.personality: In his short amount of screen time, Kenny G. shows a feeling of superiority over Nukesaku, threatening to kill the Vampire if he gets in the others' way.

characters.title: Boingo
characters.bio: Boingo is a recurring secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders. Introduced in the ""Khnum" Oingo and "Tohth" Boingo" story arc, he reappears during the "Hol Horse and Boingo" story arc.
characters.personality: As a young boy, Boingo is very introverted and timid. He prefers to act as support for his companions by showing the predictions of his Tohth rather than directly taking action. He is only comfortable around his brother, Oingo, sticking close to him and feeling lonely while away from him. His bond with his brother is deep enough that he promises to take revenge for Oingo's defeat all by himself, which causes Oingo to tear up. He is willing to interact with kind strangers, but he prefers to stay silent. With ruder strangers such as Hol Horse, he takes to hiding and often stutters in his speech.
characters.residence:
Aswan, Egypt
DIO's Mansion, Cairo, Egypt

characters.title: Imposter Captain Tennille
characters.name_ja: 偽キャプテン・テニール
characters.bio: The Imposter Captain Tennille is an unnamed secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "Dark Blue Moon" story arc.
characters.background: The assassin is one of the Tarot Card representatives sent by Enya the Hag to kill the Joestar group. Seeing that the Joestar group decided to travel by sea after the attack of Gray Fly, he killed the real captain and took his place. He threw the captain into the ocean and boarded the ship with everyone else, no one noticing that he isn't the real Tennille. He planned to kill the group one by one while inside the ship.
characters.personality: The assassin is foremost methodical, originally planning to separate the Joestar Group and eliminate them one by one. However his plan is immediately foiled by a fairly dull trick from Jotaro Kujo and he immediately dives into the water grabbing Merlai Anne hostage to bait the group. He is quite confident in Dark Blue Moon's abilities, and believes himself capable of taking on the whole group together once he's in the water.
characters.ja_kanji: 偽キャプテン・テニール

characters.title: Hol Horse
characters.bio: Hol Horse is a primary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders. He is also one of the protagonists of the spin-off manga Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak and the light novel Crazy Heartbreakers.
characters.personality: Hol Horse is portrayed like a Western, appearing to be bold and a womanizer. In contrast, his fearfulness manifests itself when he is under pressure. He is a sharp-witted deceiver and prime opportunist, tending to rely on others as well as luck to save himself.

characters.title: Devo the Cursed
characters.bio: Devo the Cursed is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "Devil" story arc.
characters.background: Prior to allying with DIO, Devo was already known all over the world as a lethal assassin hired by numerous figures in the criminal underworld. Devo carried out his assassinations by goading his targets to attack first. According to Muhammad Avdol, no one who has seen Devo's Stand lived to tell the tale, and he himself only glimpsed Devo's face once. Devo's method of execution leads many to believe that Devo curses his victims to suffer a horrific death, hence his moniker.
characters.personality: Initially, Devo appears to be an ignorant opponent, hiding in a fridge but leaving the contents on the counter. In reality, he is a clever hitman who lures his opponents into attacking him so he can make full use of his Stand. When attacked, he displays a sort of masochism, laughing and reveling in the excruciating pain because he loves to take revenge for injuries.

characters.title: Nena
characters.bio: Nena is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "Empress" story arc.
characters.background: Nena is a Stand User hired by DIO to intercept and kill the Joestar group. She used her Stand Empress to kill a beautiful young woman and wore her skin to hide her true form. She accompanies Hol Horse using this disguise, pretending to be a naive girl who fell for his charm. According to Hol Horse and Polnareff, Nena comes from a noble family in Benares, though it is unclear if this status is from the young woman she killed or completely fabricated.
characters.personality: Nena is a devious servant of DIO. Not much is known about Nena but most of the things she's seen doing indicate a twisted personality. She is an assassin at DIO's service and Enya the Hag notes that her Empress's specialty is to slowly kill her victims. Nena also hides her true form by assimilating the skin of another, prettier woman with her Stand and uses her good looks to trick her targets into thinking she's an innocent woman and approach them to plant Empress in them. Nena also keeps this habit in presence of potential allies.

characters.title: J. Geil
characters.bio: J. Geil is a primary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "Emperor and Hanged Man" story arc.
characters.background: J. Geil is the man responsible for the rape and murder of Chérie Polnareff, earning him her brother's desire for revenge. He also tried to kill Chérie's friend but failed. No one but Polnareff believed the girl's testimony on J. Geil having two right hands. It is later implied that he raped numerous girls before Chérie, as he says that he had many girls who "loved and admired" him, Chérie being just one of them.
characters.personality: It is known that J. Geil has raped and murdered several women during his life, including Chérie Polnareff, Jean Pierre Polnareff's sister. It can be inferred that he is also fairly sadistic as he states that Chérie's cries were music to his ears.

characters.title: Noriaki Kakyoin
characters.bio: Noriaki Kakyoin is a primary ally featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders. He also appears as a posthumous primary character in the spin-off manga Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak.
characters.personality: Noriaki Kakyoin is first introduced as a cruel, uncaring teenager because of DIO's brainwashing. Thus, he remorselessly attacks unrelated civilians and adopts a might makes right mindset. However, he reveals himself as a righteous, though blunt individual. Kakyoin is ruthless with his enemies but loyal to his companions.

characters.title: Enya the Hag
characters.bio: Enya the Hag, also known as Enya Geil, is a primary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "Justice" story arc. She is also mentioned several times in the fourth part, Diamond is Unbreakable, and the fifth part, Vento Aureo. She is also the protagonist of the one-shot Enya the Hag's Fangirl Diary.
characters.background: Enya bought five Stand-creating Arrows from a nineteen-year-old Diavolo and used one of them on DIO to produce his Stand. Other Arrows were later passed down to individuals such as Keicho Nijimura and Yoshihiro Kira.
characters.personality: As a servant of DIO, Enya is openly cruel and ruthless. Early on, she dispatches seven Stand users to assassinate the Joestar Group. When using Justice, she takes particular pleasure in degrading her victims, often as an extension of her vindictiveness. She forces Hol Horse to swallow his own hand and then shoot himself with his Stand, and later attempts to compel Polnareff to lick her toilets clean. Enya is also materialistic, arguing that people live to obtain what they desire, whether it is money, sex, or power. She even strikes a cat with her cane as she leaves.

characters.title: Forever
characters.bio: Forever is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "Strength" story arc.
characters.personality: Forever initially appears to be a simple, yet intuitive ape. However, he possesses a fair amount of intelligence. For instance, he was smart enough to ambush the Joestar Group by passing as an average ape to lower their guard. Forever seems to be attracted to human women and girls, looking at pin-up magazines and lusting for Merlai Anne when she's in the shower. He also smokes cigarettes and can cut his own apples, showing unusually high intelligence for an orangutan. Furthermore, he can read and quickly solve puzzle games, like a Rubik's cube.

characters.title: Arabia Fats
characters.bio: Arabia Fats is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "Sun" story arc.
characters.personality: Arabia Fats's personality is never fully shown because of how quickly he is defeated, but he is shown to be a well-prepared, patient, immoral Stand user who is willing to wait as long as it takes for the Joestar Group to die from his Stand. He made sure his hiding spot was comfortable since his Stand dramatically increases the temperature of the environment, giving himself a seat, drinks, and air conditioning. He is also shown to be clever in that he attached a large mirror to a small vehicle to take advantage of the desert's barren landscape. characters.title: Iggy
characters.bio: Iggy is a primary ally featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders. He is also the main antagonist of the first arc of the light novel Iggy the Stray Dog and the protagonist of its second arc.
characters.personality: Iggy is a highly intelligent but unruly, prideful, self-indulgent dog described as having an "awful" personality. He is primarily interested in living a peaceful, carefree life, especially with a girlfriend.

characters.title: DIO
characters.bio: He is also the protagonist of the light novel OVER HEAVEN, the main antagonist of JORGE JOESTAR, and a postmortem primary antagonist in the spin-off manga Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak.
characters.personality: Dio is consistently manipulative and violently domineering, and has repeatedly shown a lack of conscience and empathy. He is described by Hirohiko Araki as essentially being a parasite, concealing his true nature to infiltrate the Joestar family, and taking everything he can while plotting a takeover.
characters.residence:
DIO's Mansion, Cairo, Egypt
Windknight's Lot, London, England 
Joestar Mansion, Liverpool, England 
Brando House, London, England

characters.title: Gray Fly
characters.bio: Gray Fly is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "Tower of Gray" story arc.
characters.background: Gray Fly used his Stand to commit many mass murders which he disguised as accidents, including plane crashes, train derailments, and fires. In 1987, he crashed a plane in England, causing 300 casualties. He gained enough notoriety among Stand users for Muhammad Avdol to hear rumors about him, as well as his insect Stand liking to rip out tongues and eat them. As one of the tarot card Stand users, Enya the Hag sent Gray Fly to kill the Joestar Group.
characters.personality: Although he appears to be an unsuspecting old man, Gray Fly is one of DIO's many sadistic mercenaries. According to Muhammad Avdol, he is a thief responsible for numerous fatal crashes and plans all his crimes to look like accidents. Noriaki Kakyoin calls Gray Fly and his Stand "repulsive". He murders several passengers on the plane to Egypt and paints "massacre" on a wall with their blood. While Gray Fly is a hired assassin, he's fiercely loyal to DIO as well, and praises him as "the master of all Stands" before his death.

characters.title: ZZ
characters.bio: ZZ is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "Wheel of Fortune" story arc.
characters.personality: ZZ, initially a silent enemy, ominously rides around the Joestar Group and tricks them into a number of near-accidents. He seems to be a dangerous, intelligent foe, and with only his arms reaching out of the car, he could also seem physically imposing. However, ZZ is simply an arrogant and cowardly Stand user. He taunts the group and claims that they have no hope or future on their journey. He even declares that Part 3 has ended after seemingly killing Jotaro Kujo.

characters.title: Rubber Soul
characters.bio: Rubber Soul is a secondary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders, specifically the "Yellow Temperance" story arc.
characters.personality: Rubber Soul is a crass and narcissistic mercenary. He prides himself on his Stand's apparent invincibility, going as far as to blow his cover just to irritate Jotaro, and brutalize a pickpocket. Due to the way Yellow Temperance grows, Rubber Soul is liberal about what it consumes from beetles, to fruit, and even a live dog. Rubber Soul is also quite vain about his looks. When beaten to a pulp, Rubber Soul submits and gives away information on his allies. Jotaro calls him "too pathetic for words".

characters.title: Shizuka Joestar
characters.bio: Shizuka Joestar is a tertiary ally featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable.
characters.personality:
beat Ken Oyanagi
Shizuka is a baby of average temperament who is generally calm and cheerful outside a few key moments in the story.

characters.title: Anjuro "Angelo" Katagiri
characters.bio: Anjuro Katagiri, better known as Angelo, is a secondary antagonist featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "Josuke Higashikata! Meets Angelo" story arc.
characters.background: Anjuro Katagiri was born in 1964 in Morioh. At the age of 12, he was convicted for robbery and rape after being arrested by Ryohei Higashikata and was sent to a juvenile prison. Since then, he was in and out of prisons all across Japan, constantly repeating his crimes. He eventually became known as the most depraved criminal in Japan, with the newspapers giving him the nickname "Angelo". In March 1994, Angelo encountered three 14-year-old-boys. He raped two of them, killed them, and stole everything they had. When he was about to kill the third teenager, he realized the boy was the only child of wealthy parents and kidnapped the boy instead so he could demand ransom. Despite pretending to ha
characters.personality: Angelo is one of Japan's most corrupt, degenerate criminals. He has committed countless crimes, including robbery, kidnapping, ransom, and rape, since he was 12 years old. He is especially sexually depraved, having committed rape at 12 years old and raping two 14-year-old boys later on. Evidently, Angelo feels no remorse for any of his crimes, even admitting that he is a damned soul. To him, committing crimes, especially with his Stand, is a fun pastime. People that interrupt his plans infuriate him, so he naturally tries to kill them.

characters.title: Yoshihiro Kira
characters.bio: Yoshihiro Kira is a primary antagonist featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, introduced in the "Atom Heart Father" story arc.
characters.background: At some point, Yoshihiro marries an unnamed woman and has a son with her named Yoshikage on January 30, 1966. He is noted to be close to his wife, but also distant, and had never gotten into any major fights with her. The woman would end up abusing their child while Yoshihiro turned a blind eye to it.
characters.personality: Yoshihiro Kira is a devoted, crazed, father willing to protect his son against whatever challenges he faces. Yoshihiro is fully aware of Kira's nature as a sadistic serial killer, but still wishes to protect him as repentance for turning a blind eye towards his wife's abuse. Yoshihiro persuades a number of people to fight Josuke and his friends, and makes it his primary goal to throw them off Kira's trail.
characters.residence:
Kira Residence, Jozenji 1-128, Morioh, Japan 
Kotodai 1-128, Morioh, Japan

characters.title: Keicho Nijimura
characters.bio: Keicho Nijimura is a primary antagonist featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "The Nijimura Brothers" story arc.
characters.background: Around 1987, Keicho and Okuyasu's mother died, leaving their father in depression. On top of that, Japan had been going through a tough time economically and his family soon fell into poverty. Due to this, Keicho and Okuyasu were abused constantly.
characters.personality: Keicho is a meticulous and bitter teenager, marked by a tragic family life.

characters.title: Ken Oyanagi
characters.name_ja:
大柳 賢
ジャンケン小僧
characters.bio: Ken Oyanagi, alternatively referred to as Rock-Paper-Scissors Kid, is a secondary antagonist featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "Rock-Paper-Scissors Kid is Coming!" story arc.
characters.background: Ken Oyanagi is a citizen of Morioh. He lived an ordinary life as a kid until he crossed path with Yoshihiro Kira, whose Arrow recognized as a potential Stand user as he was climbing a telephone pole to steal fruits. Yoshihiro struck him in the cheek, creating his hole and making him a Stand user. The boy develops the ambition to defeat Rohan at a game of rock-paper-scissors to earn the respect of others.
characters.personality: Ken's wish is to become an adult who is respected just as much as Rohan. He has no real knowledge of Stands at the start, but he quickly learns more as the match progresses. He is decisive in his actions, willing to sacrifice himself after being defeated and taking a baby hostage to get another match against Rohan. He heavily believes that luck is on his side. Rohan describes him as a typical bouncy kid with an ordinary life and no family problems upon using Heaven's Door on him.
characters.ja_kanji:
大柳 賢
ジャンケン小僧

characters.title: Aya Tsuji
characters.bio: Aya Tsuji is a tertiary ally featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, introduced in the "Yukako Yamagishi Dreams of Cinderella" story arc and in a key role at the finale of the "Sheer Heart Attack" arc.
characters.background: Ever since she was a little girl, Aya Tsuji wished to bring happiness to others just like the fairy godmother in. And so she went to train as an esthetician in England, winning various awards from esthetician competitions around the world, including Paris, London, New York, Los Angeles, and Milan. Aya eventually opened her own beauty salon named "Cinderella" in Morioh, where she uses her Stand to perform beauty treatments on young women so that they can "find their true love."
characters.personality: Aya owns and runs a beauty salon in Morioh, with many qualifications in her profession. At heart, she is a romantic, expressing her aspiration to be like the in. Although some of her modifications are designed to force clients to come back so that she earns money, Aya truly wants to help people to find love.

characters.title: Josuke Higashikata
characters.bio: Josuke Higashikata is the protagonist of the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, and the fourth JoJo of the series. He is the illegitimate son of Joseph Joestar and Tomoko Higashikata. He also appears as one of the protagonists in the spin-off manga Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak and the light novel Crazy Heartbreakers.
characters.personality: At first impression, strangers are often intimidated by Josuke's delinquent appearance and hotheadedness, with Jotaro Kujo and Koichi Hirose both thinking Josuke was "scary" when they initially encountered him. Indeed, his "delinquent" attitude is conveyed through his rough language; he does not always display the deference towards adults and authority figures typically expected of a Japanese teenager, opting for a casual and straightforward tone. However, it is immediately apparent that Josuke has a deep capacity for kindness, with his anger simply being an extension of his tendency to display emotions openly and passionately. His outgoing and friendly nature allows him to

characters.title: Terunosuke Miyamoto
characters.bio: Terunosuke Miyamoto, originally referred to as Enigma Boy, is a secondary antagonist featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "Enigma Boy" story arc.
characters.background: Terunosuke's Stand was given to him by Yoshihiro Kira, who stabbed him with the Arrow and gave him instructions to target Koichi. While Koichi is walking home from school, Terunosuke jumps in front of him and screams, scaring the boy into showing his fear sign. He then traps him with Enigma. He also invades Tomoko Higashikata's house and turns her into a paper with his Stand.
characters.personality: Terunosuke is a smug Stand user obsessed with fear, abusing his newfound power to observe his victims' sign of fear before trapping them. He sees people as objects, as when he captured Tomoko Higashikata to lure in Josuke, kept a taxi driver trapped for transport, and constantly blackmails Josuke with Koichi's life to toy with him. Although Terunosuke claimed that his actions are not intended to harm Josuke, Tomoko and Koichi, he has no compunction threatening their lives just to intimidate his victims.

characters.title: Mikitaka Hazekura
characters.bio: Mikitaka Hazekura, also self-proclaimed as Nu Mikitakazo Nshi, is a secondary ally featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "I'm an Alien" and "Let's Live on a Transmission Tower" story arcs.
characters.personality: Whether it's an elaborate prolonged charade or the truth, Mikitaka claims to be a 216-year-old and a professional spaceship pilot who visited Earth to see if the planet is suitable for living on. He has several odd quirks related to his claims. Mikitaka and his species detest the sound of sirens and are allergic to them as sirens have distressing wavelengths. When he hears a siren, he writhes in agony and his skin turns red with a rash, while he desperately tries to find some way to escape it. He also wakes up from his sleep by stiffly standing up without bending any of his joints. When Okuyasu doubts his claims, Mikitaka starts talking strangely in an alien voice and communicates with his w

characters.title: Shigekiyo "Shigechi" Yangu
characters.bio: Shigekiyo Yangu, nicknamed Shigechi, is a secondary ally featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "'Shigechi's' Harvest" and "Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly" story arcs.
characters.background: Shigekiyo Yangu was born around 1985-1986 and seemingly lived a normal childhood. His parents gave him the nickname Shigechi and he got a pet turtle named Gonta at some point.
characters.personality: Shigechi initially comes off as naive or unintelligent, with little thought for the creative use of his powers beyond gathering lost change. He notably mentioned licking stamps to see if the glue tastes different depending on the stamp, and he keeps a chewing-gum on the back of his mother's photograph to chew on later.

characters.title: Yuya Fungami
characters.bio: Yuya Fungami is a secondary ally featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. Introduced as a secondary antagonist in "Highway Star", he becomes an ally in "Enigma Boy".
characters.background: Yuya Fungami was a member of an unnamed biker gang. Two days prior to his appearance in the story, Yuya Fungami suffered a severe motorcycle accident as he was racing across the Futatsumori Tunnel. Yuya was brought to Budogaoka General Hospital, with his spine and all four limbs broken. At one point, he was pierced by Yoshihiro Kira with the Bow and Arrow and acquired a Stand ability.
characters.personality: Yuya is a vain and selfish young man, introduced feeding off of the nutrients of unsuspecting people with his Stand.

characters.title: Yoshikage Kira
characters.bio: Yoshikage Kira is the main antagonist of the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, as well as the third main antagonist of the series overall. He also appears as the protagonist of the short story Deadman's Questions.
characters.personality: Kira is a, characterized as highly and, with a few tendencies. He dislikes any changes in his daily physical condition or routine. He takes the same route every day, puts on his clothes in the same order, and eats at the same time and in the same sequence. He is also a.

characters.title: Yukako Yamagishi
characters.bio: Yukako Yamagishi is a character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. Introduced as a secondary antagonist in the "Yukako Yamagishi Falls In Love" story arc, she becomes a tertiary ally in the "Yukako Yamagishi Dreams of Cinderella" arc.
characters.background: In February 1999, Yukako was shot with the Arrow by Keicho Nijimura, awakening in her a Stand ability. She lost consciousness and woke up completely healed. Confused, Yukako thought that the incident was a mere dream. During the new year, she enters Budogaoka High School, in the same class as Okuyasu Nijimura incidentally.
characters.personality: Yukako is introduced in the midst of a date with Koichi Hirose, initially acting demure and sweet around him. This visage quickly dissipates when she reveals her bad temper and obsession with him, which occupies the majority of her initial role in Diamond is Unbreakable.

characters.title: Tonio Trussardi
characters.name_ja: トニオ・トラサルディー
characters.bio: Tonio Trussardi is a tertiary ally featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, introduced in the "Let's Go Eat Some Italian Food" story arc. He also appears as a primary ally in the Poaching Seashore one-shot.
characters.background: Tonio Trussardi was born in Naples, Italy, but claims as his hometown.
characters.personality: Tonio Trussardi is a benevolent chef with a caring personality, highly dedicated to his craft and with the ambition to serve and cure people of their ailments through his dishes. In pursuit of this goal, he has travelled around the world, studying alternative medicine and researching exotic ingredients.
characters.ja_kanji: トニオ・トラサルディー

characters.title: Akira Otoishi
characters.bio: Akira Otoishi is a primary antagonist featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "Red Hot Chili Pepper" story arc.
characters.background: Akira Otoishi was born around 1980, and grew up being infatuated with becoming a world-famous rock-star.
characters.personality: Akira Otoishi's passion is his music, dedicated to become a Rock star and be one of the greats like and. Otoishi enjoys showing off his musical talent, even against his enemies, and wishes to impress people around the world with his music. In the most dire of circumstances, Otoishi goes so far as to play his guitar to channel his rage against Josuke Higashikata for breaking his pinky finger. He is well-versed in his craft, noting to enjoy and, along with carrying a well-built electric guitar around.

characters.title: Toyohiro Kanedaichi
characters.bio: Toyohiro Kanedaichi is the alias of a secondary antagonist featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "Let's Live on a Transmission Tower" story arc.
characters.background: Three years before the events of Diamond is Unbreakable, Kanedaichi purchases a decommissioned transmission tower from the power company for 100,000 yen and converts it into a self-sufficient house. Choosing to live in the tower out of his own introvertedness, he eventually develops a self-inflicting Stand named Super Fly that only allows him to stay within its boundaries. Kanedaichi inevitably grows tired of his condition. He eventually meets Yoshihiro Kira offscreen, who offers him a good life outside the tower if he's able to trap a Stand user inside it.
characters.personality: Initially, Kanedaichi showed himself not to be above trickery, as he tricked Josuke Higashikata into entering Super Fly while he himself plotted a means of escape. However, he states during his fight with Josuke he didn't want to kill anyone and even warns Josuke when he falls. He also says he didn't think he'd actually escape and that his plans don't usually work out. He admits he stayed in the tower in the first place because he was scared of civilization and only decided to leave because Yoshihiro tricked him by saying he would set him for life if he would trap Josuke and his friends. He proves to be regretful as he offers to treat Josuke and his friends to dinner and tend to their wounds

characters.title: Toshikazu Hazamada
characters.bio: Toshikazu Hazamada is a character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. He is introduced as a secondary antagonist in the "Toshikazu Hazamada (Surface)" story arc and later reappears as a tertiary ally. He is also the protagonist of the spin-off one-shot manga Toshikazu Hazamada's Questionable Adventure.
characters.background: Hazamada is a third-year student in class 3-C of Budogaoka private high school. He is given Stand abilities by Keicho Nijimura using the Bow and Arrow. In March, he had been rumored to have had an argument with his friend the night before his friend dug out his own eyeball with a ballpoint pen. The friend's motive for doing this was unknown as he said he already had the eyeball in his hand before realizing what he was doing. Apparently, the friend had been taken control of by Hazamada's Stand Surface, spurring Tamami Kobayashi to investigate.
characters.personality: Toshikazu Hazamada is a Stand user with a vile personality, having a number of pathetic and despicable traits. Reading his memories with Heaven's Door, Rohan Kishibe reveals that Hazamada enjoys subjugating those weaker than himself, notably kittens and small animals. When he hears a biker mock him, Hazamada's reaction is to try to slash apart his cheek with a cutter. As a Stand user, he also misuses his ability. After getting into an argument with a classmate over a petty subject (a TV show or an idol), Hazamada had him gouge his eye out with Surface. characters.title: Tamami Kobayashi
characters.bio: Tamami Kobayashi is a secondary antagonist featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, introduced in the "Koichi Hirose (Echoes)" story arc.
characters.background: Tamami Kobayashi was born around 1979. Two years prior to the events of Diamond is Unbreakable, he graduated from Budogaoka High School in Morioh.
characters.personality: Tamami Kobayashi is a sly hustler with a despicable personality.

characters.title: Okuyasu Nijimura
characters.bio: Okuyasu Nijimura is a primary ally featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable.
characters.personality: Okuyasu Nijimura is an impulsive and violent teenager with a nonetheless good heart.

characters.title: Former Tama
characters.bio: Tama is a secondary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, introduced in the "Cats Love Yoshikage Kira" story arc.
characters.personality: Tama is a typical cat who is stubborn and territorial to his spot in the cellar when Shinobu Kawajiri attempts to chase him out. When his Stand ability manifests, he resurrects as a plant with the memories of his previous life and because of this he has similar characteristics of any normal cat. Like all cats, Stray Cat has a hunter instinct and is seen chasing after insects, thrown pieces of paper, and birds. He is proud of his former fur and tail. He loves running and jumping but cannot do so as a plant. Stray Cat likes tuna, shrimp, sticking his head in paper sacks, watching TV, and being praised. characters.residence:
Nijimura Residence, Jozenji 4-1280, Morioh, Japan
Kawajiri Residence, Morioh, Japan

characters.title: Polpo
characters.bio: Polpo is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "Meet the Gangster Behind the Wall" and the "Joining the Gang" story arcs.
characters.background: Little is known about Polpo's past. It is known that he was at one point recruited into Passione and then became a capo, considered rather trustworthy within the organization and responsible for handling matters related to Stands.
characters.personality: Polpo acts like a stereotypical Mafia don, showing an affable side and an appreciation for various works of art, quoting philosophers and gastronomy. His table manners are, however, lacking, showing that his sophistication is superficial.

characters.title: Melone
characters.bio: Melone is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "Baby Face" story arc. He is also the protagonist of the short story "Cuore di Genitore, Ignaro il Figlio."
characters.background: Melone was a member of La Squadra Esecuzioni, a team of nine assassins working within Passione. However, the team was frustrated they only received compensation for each kills while the rest of the gang was getting rich from the drug trade. One day their teammates Sorbet and Gelato disappeared while they were trying to investigate the Boss's past. They found Gelato choked on a gag in his house, with a piece of paper on which was written the word "punishment". Later, the team received the sectioned body parts of Sorbet encased in formaldehyde, showing the team the power of the Boss. They despaired of ever finding about the Boss. However, they then heard about Trish Una, and thought that she w
characters.personality: Melone shows himself to be a polite man in most circumstances. Approaching every activity with cold professionalism, he physically inspects his future victims, looking at them more like cattle to breed his Stand than fellow human beings. The TV anime also emphasizes his salacious and predatory nature, showing him openly licking his lips in delight as he observes a beautiful woman's legs and feet; something his teammates are openly perturbed of.

characters.title: Giorno Giovanna
characters.name_ja: ジョルノ・ジョバァーナ
characters.bio: Giorno Giovanna is the protagonist of the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, and the fifth JoJo of the series.
characters.personality: Giorno's childhood was filled with unhappiness and loneliness due to bullying and abuse by his stepfather. As a result, he was initially cold and uncaring towards everyone and believed himself to be scum just for the way people treated him. Those who knew him would easily think he'd grow up to become a twisted individual. This changed when he befriended an injured gangster he saved. As the man protected Giorno from those who did him wrong in return for his aid, he learned he could trust people. Since then, he has become a more confident and solicitous person.

characters.personality: Bruno Bucciarati, first introduced as a sly gangster, is quickly revealed to be a righteous and extremely determined, if brutal, individual.

characters.title: Risotto Nero
characters.bio: Risotto Nero is a primary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "King Crimson vs. Metallica" story arc. He is also the protagonist of the short story "Risotto Nero Osserva."
characters.background: Risotto was born in in 1974. When he was 14 years old, his cousin's child was run over by a drunk driver. Though the driver was punished by the law, Risotto could not forgive him and, four years later, at age 18, he assassinated the driver. From then on, Risotto began living life in the underworld. He would eventually obtain a Stand at the age of 21 and subsequently became the leader of La Squadra Esecuzioni, a branch of the Italian mafia gang Passione. Risotto's team would go on to assassinate politicians, American gangsters, and anyone who posed a threat to the organization.
characters.personality: Risotto is a stoic and goal-oriented individual, befitting as the leader of La Squadra Esecuzioni. He goes through great lengths to find out the identity of The Boss, and vows to avenge the deaths of his men. Despite his failure to succeed, The Boss congratulates Risotto on his efforts and claims that his men would be proud of his accomplishments. Risotto has, in fact, held a particularly vindictive nature even before joining the underworld, having in his youth murdered the man who ran over his cousin's child as an act of revenge, in spite of the culprit having legally served his sentence for the crime.

characters.title: Pannacotta Fugo
characters.name_ja: パンナコッタ・フーゴ
characters.bio: Pannacotta Fugo is a primary ally featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo. He is also the protagonist of the light novel Purple Haze Feedback and a primary character in the light novel Golden Heart, Golden Ring.
characters.personality: Pannacotta Fugo is a serious and caring but easily enraged teenager, ultimately being a restrained individual.
characters.ja_kanji: パンナコッタ・フーゴ

characters.title: Leone Abbacchio
characters.name_ja: レオーネ・アバッキオ
characters.bio: Leone Abbacchio is a primary ally featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo.
characters.background: Abbacchio became a police officer after graduating high school. He was very sincere about protecting people, but not long after he was stationed in his area, he realized his job had a lot of contradictions. Though the police officers risked their lives to protect the people, the people are not grateful, always trying to get out of punishments and sometimes even accusing the officers of not doing their job. And even the criminals who have been put away by the police can easily be released if they have enough money. Abbacchio began to learn of these contradictions, and one night while on patrol, he came across a man working with a harlot. The man said that he and the girl were just trying to h
characters.personality: Leone Abbacchio is a somber, quite bitter, yet dedicated member of Bucciarati's team.
characters.ja_kanji: レオーネ・アバッキオ

characters.title: Guido Mista
characters.bio: Guido Mista is a primary ally featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo.
characters.personality: Easy-going and relaxed whenever the number "4" is not involved, Guido Mista is also a resolute gunslinger when in battle.

characters.title: Prosciutto
characters.bio: Prosciutto is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "Express Train to Florence" and "The Grateful Dead" story arcs. He is also one of the protagonists of the short story "Ago e Filo, il Mio Orgoglio."
characters.background: Prosciutto was a member of La Squadra Esecuzioni, a team of nine assassins working within Passione. However, the team was frustrated they only received compensation for each kills while the rest of the gang was getting rich from the drug trade. One day their teammates Sorbet and Gelato disappeared while they were trying to investigate the Boss's past. They found Gelato choked on a gag in his house, with a piece of paper on which was written the word "punishment". Later, the team received the sectioned body parts of Sorbet encased in formaldehyde, showing the team the power of the Boss. They despaired of ever finding about the Boss. However, they then heard about Trish Una, and thought that s
characters.personality: Prosciutto is a fairly straight-forward gangster. He is shown to always be focused on his mission and adhering to La Squadra's motto of holding one's ground, even mortally wounded, to the letter. He puts this into practice and expects his underling(s) to also do the same. He doesn't tolerate any deviance of this attitude, especially when it's from his comrades and subordinates, and failing to adhere to the ideal such as in the case of Pesci on one occasion, would result in a brief beating being handed out as a reminder. Prosciutto is usually very composed, meeting any obstacle with cold efficiency, and carrying out his objectives without hesitation.

characters.title: Narancia Ghirga
characters.bio: Narancia Ghirga is a primary ally featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo.
characters.personality: Narancia Ghirga is a rough and choleric teenager who demonstrates great loyalty to his comrades.

characters.title: Pesci
characters.bio: Pesci is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "The Grateful Dead" story arc. He is also one of the protagonists of the short story "Ago e Filo, il Mio Orgoglio."
characters.background: Pesci was a member of La Squadra Esecuzioni, a team of nine assassins working within Passione. However, the team was frustrated they only received compensation for each kills while the rest of the gang was getting rich from the drug trade. One day their teammates Sorbet and Gelato disappeared while they were trying to investigate the Boss's past. They found Gelato choked on a gag in his house, with a piece of paper on which was written the word "punishment". Later, the team received the sectioned body parts of Sorbet encased in formaldehyde, showing the team the power of the Boss.
characters.personality: Pesci is introduced as a weak-willed man, using threats when he should act, and is overall rather timid. Pesci lacks nerves and composure, panicking when the ice he uses to preserve himself from The Grateful Dead's power is destroyed and begs for his life when Mista has him at point-blank range.

characters.title: Illuso
characters.bio: Illuso is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "Man in the Mirror and Purple Haze" story arc. He is also one of the protagonists of the short story "Il Gatto Randagio Se Ne Va con il Vento di Primavera."
characters.background: Illuso was a member of La Squadra Esecuzioni, a team of nine assassins working within Passione. However, the team was frustrated they only received compensation for each kills while the rest of the gang was getting rich from the drug trade. One day their teammates Sorbet and Gelato disappeared while they were trying to investigate the Boss's past. characters.personality: Illuso appears before Fugo, Abbacchio, and Giorno as a confident and smug assassin. He expresses great confidence and revels in Man in the Mirror's ability. Illuso is very laid-back in the beginning, aiming to dispatch Bucciarati's men one by one and enjoys torturing them while sneering at their inability to fight back. He is confident enough in the Mirror World's power that he'd leave Fugo to engage the other two. Illuso underestimates his opponents as a result, which leads to him being repeatedly baited into making himself vulnerable.

characters.title: Squalo
characters.bio: Squalo is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "Clash and Talking Head" story arc.
characters.personality: Squalo is a hot-headed individual, being the most aggressive of his partnership with Tizzano and letting the latter do most of the thinking. Squalo is however adept at using the most of his environment. Squalo is also more prone to panic, especially when he is pursued by Narancia.

characters.title: Cioccolata
characters.bio: Cioccolata is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "Green Day and Oasis" story arc. He is also the protagonist of the short story "Cioccolata Adotta un Cane".
characters.background: A young Cioccolata was constantly at the top of his class. When he was fourteen years old, he volunteered to take care of bedridden elderly people and received a commendation from the town mayor himself. In truth, however, Cioccolata did not actually take care of the elderly at all. Instead, he intentionally fed them unhygienic food and illegal drugs, and would then whisper into their ears about how no one would visit them and other emotionally destructive things. This torment eventually drove old people to despair and eventually commit suicide. He even filmed the expressions of his helpless victims and their deaths. Diavolo found that he has kept over 25 tapes worth of this material. After
characters.personality: Cioccolata is a skilled manipulative sadist. His insanity, brutality, and sadism are strong enough to disgust even Diavolo, who avoids using him for missions unless he feels that it's absolutely necessary. According to Diavolo, Cioccolata was a former surgeon dismissed from his hospital for a medical accident two years before the start of Vento Aureo. However, the deaths were not accidents but were just cover-ups for Cioccolata to freely operate on them, diagnosing healthy patients ill before doing so. He would sometimes limit their anesthetics so the patients would regain consciousness mid-operation, allowing him to delight in the patient's suffering and death.

characters.title: Sale
characters.bio: Sale is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "Sex Pistols Appears" story arc.
characters.personality: Compared to Zucchero, Sale is a more careful, ambitious and methodical man. He appears more focused than his partner Mario Zucchero, coming to the conclusion that 6 billion lire would drastically improve his standing within Passione. Opportunistic, he and Zucchero work as a duo to secure Polpo's treasure, brave enough to oppose Bucciarati's team of six individually.

characters.title: Formaggio
characters.bio: Formaggio is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "Narancia's Aerosmith" story arc. He is also a primary ally in the short story "Il Gatto Randagio Se Ne Va con il Vento di Primavera."

However, the team was frustrated they only received compensation for each kills while the rest of the gang was getting rich from the drug trade. One day their teammates Sorbet and Gelato disappeared while they were trying to investigate the Boss's past. They found Gelato choked on a gag in his house, with a piece of paper on which was written the word "punishment". Later, the team received the sectioned body parts of Sorbet encased in formaldehyde, showing the team the power of the Boss. They despaired of ever finding about the Boss. characters.personality: Formaggio comes off as a very relaxed individual. Unlike most of the pursuing assassins, Formaggio introduces himself openly to Narancia, trying to chit-chat, and laughing at his own jokes. In the TV anime adaptation, this side of him is expanded upon by showing him acting the same way toward his teammate Pesci with a dark joke, inviting several teammates to a watch a football match, and taunting Illuso back when being sneered at.

characters.title: Carne
characters.bio: Carne is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo.
characters.personality: While Carne displays no personality before his death, it can be assumed that he was loyal to Diavolo enough to give his life for him. As he approaches Team Bucciarati with no visible weapons and a self-assuring smile, he was likely dispatched knowing the implications of his Stand ability.

characters.title: Secco
characters.bio: Secco is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "Green Day and Oasis" story arc. He is also a primary ally in the short story "Cioccolata Adotta un Cane".
characters.background: Secco was once one of Cioccolata's 'patients', used to satiate the latter's morbid desire to see others die slowly and painfully. He is somehow spared and becomes the mad doctor's loyal sidekick. Eventually, they were recruited into Passione, and both received Stands.
characters.personality: Very little is known about Secco, as not even the boss was able to find concrete information regarding his past. It's known he was once a patient of Cioccolata; however, as he shared Cioccolata's warped mind and thoughts of spreading suffering, they formed a partnership. Secco obeys him as if he were a pet. When he was first introduced, Secco made various noises and gestures to communicate rather than words, indicating nonverbal tendencies or unintelligence. Cioccolata sends him to film people's expressions as they die while he tortures them with his Green Day and occasionally rubs Secco's head for doing a good job, and rewards him with sugar cubes.

characters.title: Scolippi
characters.bio: Scolippi is a tertiary character featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "Sleeping Slaves" story arc.
characters.background: As a child, Scolippi suddenly discovered his stand Rolling Stones and learned of its abilities. He later became a professional sculptor, not attaining fame, yet still making a decent living.
characters.personality: Scolippi appears to be somewhat withdrawn and meek, yet benevolent. He is said to have avoided showing himself to his girlfriend's father despite having a committed relationship with her.

characters.title: Mario Zucchero
characters.bio: Mario Zucchero is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "Mystery of Soft Machine" and "Moody Blues's Counterattack" story arcs.
characters.personality: Mario Zucchero is a vain and careless individual compared to his partner Sale: when asked what he would do with 6 billion lire, Zucchero answers that he would spend it on vacation trips and women, not thinking about how the money could help him rise within Passione.

characters.title: Trish Una
characters.bio: Trish Una is a primary ally featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo.
characters.background: Trish is the daughter of Diavolo and Donatella Una, conceived without Diavolo's knowledge. Initially she's stated to be born on April 19, 1986, in, but it was then changed to June 8, 1985. She lived a normal life with her mother Donatella until the latter fell ill and began looking for a certain "Solid Naso," which caught the attention of the gang Passione. After Donatella's passing, Passione found out about her parentage, and she became the center of attention of two factions: firstly her father's loyal underlings who tried to secure her, and then La Squadra Esecuzioni who wanted to kidnap Trish to get to the Boss. Agents loyal to the Boss quickly took her but the traitor assassins continu
characters.personality: Trish is first introduced as a spoiled, selfish girl with high-class tastes. Indeed, as soon as she is in the care of Team Bucciarati, she immediately demands branded cosmetic products and only sparkling water despite the severity of the mission. This is later revealed to be a way to hide her insecurities, although her self-doubt is still apparent in instances, such as later expressing her nervousness to Bucciarati for whether she and her father would get along or not.

characters.title: Tizzano
characters.bio: Tizzano is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "Clash and Talking Head" story arc.
characters.personality: Tizzano is a tactical and level-headed assassin who works alongside his partner Squalo. Compared to Squalo, Tizzano is much calmer and much more attentive in treacherous situations, such as their fight against Narancia. Tizzano is presented to have a deep bond with his partner, willing to take damage from Aerosmith in order to assure his safety.

characters.bio: Ghiaccio is a secondary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, specifically the "White Album" story arc. He is also a primary ally in the short story "Cuore di Genitore, Ignaro il Figlio."

characters.personality: Ghiaccio is a crass and irritable assassin, obsessed with idioms and pursuing his mission.

characters.title: Enrico Pucci
characters.bio: Enrico Pucci is the main antagonist of the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, as well as the fifth main antagonist of the series overall.
characters.personality: The priest Enrico Pucci is an amicable man turned fanatic, committed to a heretical notion of God's will and DIO's plan.

characters.bio: Miuccia Miuller, commonly known as Miu Miu, is a secondary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, specifically the "Jail House Lock!" story arc.
characters.background: Miu Miu is the lead guard in charge of the visiting room and front gate areas of the Green Dolphin Street Prison. Working alongside Whitesnake, Miu Miu has been preventing Stand users from escaping the prison thanks to her power. After Enrico Pucci fuses with The Green Baby, she is sent out to make sure Jolyne Cujoh does not meddle with Pucci's affairs anymore.

characters.title: Jolyne Cujoh
characters.bio: Jolyne Cujoh is the protagonist of the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, and the sixth JoJo of the series. She is the daughter of Jotaro Kujo, the protagonist of Stardust Crusaders, and an American woman.
characters.personality: During her adolescence, Jolyne was lonely and longed for affection from her father, Jotaro. When Jolyne was 14, she found a wallet containing five dollars. The father of the wallet owner accused her of stealing it and called the police, causing Jolyne to panic and steal their car before she was arrested. She later admitted that she did not even know why she did it, only knowing that her father would eventually come to her rescue. Due to her father's absence, Jolyne became dependent on the affection and approval of those around her. She was ready to cover Romeo's accident, resulting in her being sentenced to 15 years in prison for it.

characters.title: Gwess
characters.bio: Gwess is a secondary antagonist and, later on, tertiary ally featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean. She is introduced in the "Prisoner FE40536: Jolyne Cujoh" story arc as Jolyne Cujoh's first enemy Stand user.
characters.background: According to her privilege card, Gwess was sentenced to 12 years in prison after being charged with arson, attempted murder, and parole violation.
characters.personality: Gwess is a capricious inmate who can easily put on a facade of kindness but snap and reveal her moody, ferocious nature in the next moment.

characters.title: Donatello Versus
characters.name_ja: ドナテロ・ヴェルサス
characters.bio: Donatello Versus is a secondary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, specifically the "Under World" story arc.
characters.background: Donatello Versus was raised by his mother and stepfather, a man who "did nothing but tell long stories of his womanizing ways," who his mother married at an unknown point in Versus's life.
characters.personality: Having been abandoned, abused, and unjustly imprisoned, Donatello Versus developed a grudge against society at large, desiring to become happy at any cost. Enrico Pucci finds Donatello aimlessly drifting through life, getting by on petty crime, and without having ever been employed. Even though he inherited DIO's ruthlessness, selfishness, and quick thinking, Donatello lacks his father's megalomania or cunning. As such, although he seems more outwardly well-adjusted, Versus is, in fact, incredibly rash and impulsive.
characters.ja_kanji: ドナテロ・ヴェルサス

characters.title: Rikiel
characters.bio: Rikiel is a secondary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, specifically the "Sky High" story arc.
characters.background: Prior to meeting Pucci and obtaining a Stand, Rikiel suffered from what seemed to be constant panic attacks: his eyelids constantly fell and his knees gave out. He would attempt to take exams in school, only to suffer from his conditions, which caused him to stop attending school. These conditions were so severe that he wasn't even able to drive a car, and this dramatically decreased his self-confidence.
characters.personality: Rikiel is initially a meek youth distraught by the numerous afflictions he suffers from, causing him to have no hope for his future and a damaged spirit. He spent his life disturbed by an unknown affliction with seemingly random symptoms: his eyelids would close, it'd become hard to breathe, and he'd start panicking as a result. Rikiel is riddled with anxiety and immediately breaks down in front of Pucci during their first encounter.

characters.title: Ungalo
characters.bio: Ungalo is a secondary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, specifically the "Bohemian Rhapsody" story arc.
characters.background: Prior to going to Florida (drawn by Enrico Pucci's "gravitational force"), Ungalo was a drug addict who lived a life of despair, not yet aware of his Stand ability Bohemian Rhapsody.
characters.personality: Inheriting his father's worst traits, Ungalo is a sadistic, violent, and incredibly vulgar individual with a short temper. He holds a grudge against the world for his circumstances, wishing to plunge it into despair and chaos.

characters.title: Emporio Alnino
characters.name_ja: エンポリオ・アルニーニョ
characters.bio: Emporio Alnino is a primary ally featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.background: Emporio was born to an unnamed prisoner in Green Dolphin Street Prison. Since then, he has lived there in secret with the help of his Stand, Burning Down the House, by using it to hide within a "ghost room" on the premises. His mother was killed by Enrico Pucci, who stole her DISCs and left her to slowly rot away. The boy kept a from his mother's body as a keepsake and a precaution against Whitesnake. However, Pucci was originally unaware of Emporio's existence. At one point, Emporio also meets Weather Report and Narciso Anasui, trusting them enough to let them dwell in his ghost room.
characters.personality: Emporio is first shown as a timid, awkward boy, who is rather unwilling to fight.
characters.ja_kanji: エンポリオ・アルニーニョ
characters.residence: Ghost Room, Green Dolphin Street Prison

characters.title: Narciso Anasui
characters.bio: Narciso Anasui is a primary ally featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.background: Born with a condition that compels him to disassemble anything he sees, Anasui had a troubled childhood. He meticulously took apart pocket watches, toys, and other items within his reach. At the age of ten, he was admitted to a psychiatric facility for six months after disassembling his neighbor's Porsche. One time, he even disassembled a high-voltage utility pole.
characters.personality: A significant aspect of Anasui's character is his intense devotion to Jolyne. Falling in love with her at first sight, he admires her focus and determination, which he claims inspire him and give him hope for his future. Viewing himself as Jolyne's protector, Anasui strives to earn her love and trust, declaring his intent to protect her at all costs so they can eventually get married. He believes that he can protect her better than Jotaro Kujo or Weather Report, and frequently uses his Stand ability to shield Jolyne, such as absorbing C-MOON's gravity inversion to give her time to strike back. His desire to become Jolyne's protector can be overzealous at times, such as when he instructs F.F.

characters.title: Kenzou
characters.bio: Kenzou is a secondary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, specifically the "Enter the Dragon's Dream" story arc.
characters.background: When he was 37 years of age, Kenzou was the leader of a very popular cult that included Hollywood stars and other famous people, reaching 30,000 members. However, his sect was soon investigated by the police and FBI. Subsequently, Kenzou and thirty four members of his cult attempted a mass suicide. Kenzou drugged everyone and put fire to the building, burning everyone. However, Kenzou collapsed in a surprisingly safe spot where the collapse of the walls shielded him from the flames and the smoke and barely survived. He subsequently received a total 280 year-sentence in Green Dolphin Street Prison for this crime, and endeavored to climb back up to the upper echelons of society where he could
characters.personality: Kenzou is a confident martial artist and assassin with delusions of grandeur.

characters.title: The Green Baby
characters.bio: The Green Baby is a secondary antagonist and key character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, specifically the "AWAKEN" story arc.
characters.personality: The Green Baby largely behaves as a normal infant would, showcasing a general curiosity to its surroundings and a habit of chewing on things like Anasui's hair. It also has a tendency to fall asleep frequently and eat dirt, which Jolyne surmises is due to it being a plant. However, it has a particular interest in the star birthmark, trying to get closer to it and being attached to Jolyne. It is also especially drawn toward the audible incitement of the 14 phrases and DIO's Bone.

characters.title: Ermes Costello
characters.name_ja: エルメェス・コステロ
characters.bio: Ermes Costello is a primary ally featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.background: Ermes is of at least partial Mexican descent through her immigrant father. She had lived her youth in the slums, her family managing a restaurant there. She had an elder sister named Gloria, who was 10 years older than her. In the anime, it is shown that their mother passed away when Ermes was a kid, so Gloria took on the role of being Ermes's mother. Gloria would eventually inherit the restaurant at the age of 20 but would receive no assistance from her little sister. Gloria wanted Ermes to help at the restaurant but Ermes wanted a sports scholarship in cross-country and to go to college.
characters.personality: Ermes Costello is a headstrong, pragmatic, and down-to-earth person, who has been consumed by a thirst for revenge for much of her youth.
characters.ja_kanji: エルメェス・コステロ

characters.title: Lang Rangler
characters.bio: Lang Rangler is a secondary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, specifically the "Operation Savage Garden" story arc.
characters.background: Lang Rangler was sentenced to Green Dolphin Street Prison for murdering a female professor, stabbing her sixty-nine times. At an unknown point while in prison, he gained his Stand, Jumpin' Jack Flash. It's unspecified whether he naturally acquired his ability or was granted to him via a Stand DISC by Enrico Pucci.
characters.personality: Lang Rangler is a calm and analytical Stand user who is nonetheless prone to overconfidence and murderous outbursts.

characters.title: Johngalli A.
characters.bio: Johngalli A. is a secondary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, specifically the "The Visitor" story arc.
characters.background: Johngalli A. is one of DIO's followers and fanatically devoted to him. He was a former soldier and skilled sniper. He has severe cataracts, greatly impairing his eyesight.
characters.personality: As a loyal follower of DIO, Johngalli A. shares his plan with Enrico Pucci. He expresses his wish to get revenge for DIO and claims how the Joestars robbed his heart of his emotional anchor, although this occurs in an illusion that Jolyne and Jotaro are witnessing by Whitesnake.

characters.title: D an G
characters.bio: D an G is a secondary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, and introduced in the "Yo-Yo Ma is Coming!" story arc.
characters.background: In 1999, D an G was a police officer who believed in 's prophecy of the end of the world coming in the year 2000. Because of this, he went around shooting several people he didn't like near the start of the new millennium, using his status as a policeman to erase his traces. Once the panic died down, he was quickly arrested and sent to Green Dolphin Street Prison for 20 years. It's explained that D an G is held in the Maximum Security for his protection because his identity as an ex-cop in prison would otherwise get him killed. It's unknown if he was given his Stand by Pucci or developed it.
characters.personality: In most of his time shown, he has a completely stoic personality, but it's assumed that he is hateful and homicidal judging by the actions that got him arrested. Back in 1999, D an G believed in 's predictions about the end of the world and decided to commit several murders, using his status as a policeman to hide his crimes until he was found out.

characters.title: Magent Magent
characters.name_ja: マジェント・マジェント
characters.bio: Magent Magent is a recurring secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, introduced in the "Wrecking Ball" story arc.
characters.personality: Magent Magent is presented as an affable and genial henchman to Funny Valentine, trying to bond with his new partner Wekapipo through idle chat or questionable jokes. However, he is quickly exasperated by Wekapipo's gloomy attitude and comes to hate him for leaving him behind in the cold.
characters.ja_kanji: マジェント・マジェント

characters.title: Oyecomova
characters.bio: Oyecomova is a secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, introduced in the "Gyro Zeppeli's Destiny" story arc.
characters.background: Oyecomova is a terrorist from the Kingdom of Naples. Two years before the Steel Ball Run, he had attempted to assassinate the king by blowing up his carriage. Although the king was fortunate not to be inside, five people had died instead, including two children. Oyecomova was arrested and imprisoned to await his execution, but within the prison that he was being held at, Oyecomova managed to kill a guard by putting gunpowder in his ear.
characters.personality: Oyecomova is a fairly disturbing individual. At first, he seems to be fairly passive, from where he actually warns others not to touch him due to his Stand. However, this is apparently a front—he has shown that he has no qualms about killing others and displays fierce dedication to the missions he takes up, seen where he was ready to resume his plot to assassinate the King of Italy after killing Gyro Zeppeli.

characters.title: Blackmore
characters.bio: Blackmore is a secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, introduced in the "The Green Tomb" story arc.
characters.personality: Blackmore is an efficient assassin, deeply loyal to Valentine; equally believing in his authority and cause.
