characters.title: D-I-S-C-O
characters.bio: D-I-S-C-O is a secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, specifically in the "Chocolate Disco" story arc.
characters.personality: D-I-S-C-O has a rather expressionless face and personality. He is very quiet and prefers to never speak more than is necessary, speaking only to reveal his Stand's name.

characters.title: Axl RO
characters.bio: Axl RO is a secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, specifically in the "Civil War" story arc.
characters.background: During his youth, Axl RO wanted to be a musician but was drafted into the army in 1863, where he was stationed in a tree to be a lookout in Gettysburg, a remote town in Pennsylvania. Having no one to talk to, and being completely alone, Axl resorted to alcohol to relieve his despair. His job had been to light the lamp in order to warn the soldiers nearby of an incoming enemy troop. However, he did not do so in fear that the enemy would find him in the tree and kill him. Thus, he silently sat there and finished his drink as the town was burned to ashes.
characters.personality: Axl's most characteristic trait is his desire to purify himself from his sins in order to rid himself of the ghosts of his past comrades haunting him.

characters.title: Hot Pants
characters.bio: Hot Pants is a secondary character featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run. She serves as a tertiary antagonist to Gyro and Johnny, and as a secondary ally to Lucy Steel.
characters.background: When she was a child, Hot Pants went to collect nuts in the woods with her younger brother. Attacked by a grizzly bear, they hid in a rock crevice. Injured and scared, Hot Pants pushed her brother out of the crevice - saving herself at the price of his life. The people in her hometown were very kind to her and her parents after the "tragic accident", but Hot Pants became unable to bear the burden of the truth surrounding her brother's death.
characters.personality: Hot Pants is introduced as a rough and vindictive individual, accusing Johnny and Gyro of stealing her supplies and immediately attacking them upon their first meeting. Even when Johnny disproves Hot Pants's accusations, Hot Pants merely backs off and doesn't apologize for her attack, claiming that the duo was guilty of eating some of her meat anyway. This behavior earns her a particular enmity from Gyro's part, who would see her as an enemy.

characters.title: Pocoloco
characters.bio: Pocoloco is a secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: Pocoloco was born in Georgia in 1869. On September 20, 1890, Pocoloco headed down to the city to gamble. After losing, he met a fortune teller on the side of the road who told him that he is at the opposite of his life's most inauspicious moment. He would reach the greatest peak of his life over the next two months and would have a 1 in five billion chance of good luck.
characters.personality: Pocoloco is an optimistic, cheerful, and happy-go-lucky man who drifts through life at his own pace. He is not bitter over his poor background, but instead clings to a simple belief that his circumstances can turn around if fortune finally comes his way. Pocoloco's belief in luck is the core of his outlook. After being told his fortune will dramatically improve within the next two months, he becomes openly confident and acts as if his success is already guaranteed, talking himself up as an extraordinarily lucky man and interpreting events through that lens. Consequently, he lies on the ground and idly counts clouds, deciding he'll live an easy life rather than working. Pocoloco's optimism is

characters.title: Sandman
characters.name_ja:
サンドマン（砂男）
サウンドマン
characters.bio: Sandman, real name Soundman, is a secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: Sandman was born in a Native American community in the Arizona Desert, although "Sandman" is a misnomer given to him by the white settlers who met him; in his native language his name means "He Who Creates 'Sound" which would be more properly translated as "Soundman". Due to his academic interest the white settlers' language and his own stubborn personality, he was ostracized by his own people. Throughout his life, he developed a running technique that allows him to run long distances without having to rest for long periods, something his own tribe and the settlers have never seen before.
characters.personality: Sandman is a Native American with a singular and cynical outlook on the world but who is also loyal to his people.
characters.ja_kanji:
サンドマン（砂男）
サウンドマン
families: She Who Dances with the Leaves

characters.title: Ringo Roadagain
characters.name_ja: リンゴォ・ロードアゲイン
characters.bio: Ringo Roadagain is a secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, specifically the "The World of Man" story arc.
characters.background: From birth, Ringo was sickly. As a young boy, he had fragile skin and was often ill. Ringo's father was drafted and sent to war, later escaped, was imprisoned, and then died because of a disease. Ringo's family, branded as traitors, were forced to travel across the country. Ringo, at the age of ten, woke up one night to a large man in military uniform by his bed and his family, his mother and two sisters, killed underneath the table that had a bloody knife sticking on top of it. The large man looming over Ringo then tried to rape him but was greeted with a gun, which Ringo slyly took from the large man, pointing towards him. Ringo quickly shot the man as he charged at him. It was after this
characters.personality: When he was a child, Ringo was of particularly weak constitution, as he easily bled and fell ill frequently. When a deserter killed his family and threatened to kill him, Ringo awakened his fighting spirit and shot the man dead to defend himself. At this point, Ringo ceased to be afflicted with illness and it shaped his entire mindset.

characters.title: Mountain Tim
characters.bio: Mountain Tim is a secondary ally featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run. He is also the protagonist of the light novel Lonesome Tim.
characters.personality: Mountain Tim is confident and composed, with a strong sense of responsibility toward others. Sheriff Derek describes him as a well-liked cowboy with friends throughout the American West. Tim is unwilling to overlook the murders of his fellow competitors, explaining that many of the racers are his friends and that he cannot race with peace of mind while a murderer is among them.

characters.title: Eleven Men
characters.bio: The Eleven Men are a group of unnamed secondary antagonists featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, specifically in the "The Promised Land: Sugar Mountain" story arc.
characters.personality: Not much is known about their personalities beyond stoicism, but they have an uncanny ability to act in unison. They are also ruthless murderers, patiently hunting after Gyro and Johnny then during their fight, and exploit any setback thrown to them, using their comrades' corpses as shields and hiding spots for surprise attacks. Despite their ruthlessness, they seem to have a sense of honor, as they don't go out of their way to kill anyone but Johnny and Gyro, and the only surviving gunman left Johnny alone after acquiring the Corpse Part from him.

characters.title: Lucy Steel
characters.name_ja: ルーシー・スティール
characters.bio: Lucy Steel, née Pendleton, is a primary ally featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run. She is also a tertiary character in the eighth part, JoJolion.
characters.background: Lucy lived in a family of six siblings and was the second eldest of the bunch. Her father, Adam Pendleton, was a farmer who owned a small land in Oklahoma. At one point, Lucy met Steven Steel on the streets when he was penniless and drunk, listening to him mumbling about his plan of promoting a great horserace. Lucy encouraged him to run it and make it as grandiose as it could be with a continent-spanning route and a prize in the millions of dollars. Steven scoffed at the girl's ridiculous suggestions and left to drink.
characters.personality: Lucy is an intelligent, gentle and courageous girl despite facing many dangerous situations.

characters.name_ja: ポーク・パイ・ハット小僧
characters.bio: Pork Pie Hat Kid is a secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, specifically the "Tusk" story arc.
characters.personality: Pork Pie Hat Kid appears to be a goofy and deranged individual. He seems to have little conception of normalcy and shows several disturbing habits. For instance, he has a tendency to eat and drink anything that comes into his view such as the ink of a pen (finding it delicious) or a whole coffee pot, and even wonders if he could eat his broken teeth. He is also shown hitting a bag with a rock to search it instead of opening it. Like any of Valentine's subordinates, he has little problem with using violence and killing his targets.

characters.title: Kei Nijimura
characters.bio: Kei Nijimura is a secondary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. Appearing as an antagonist in the "Paisley Park and Born This Way" story arc, she then becomes an ally in "The Wonder of You" story arc.
characters.background: Kei Nijimura was born around 1989 to Holy Joestar-Kira and Yoshiteru Kira, and she is Yoshikage Kira's little sister.
characters.personality: Nijimura typically performs all the duties expected of a maid and shows no emotion whatsoever. It is eventually revealed her emotionless demeanor is a facade when Josuke asks her if she attacked him on the Higashikatas' orders. Nijimura reacts harshly to this, showing that she hates the Higashikatas, calling them "the goddamn Higashikatas." She also threatens to kill Josuke if he approaches Holy because she is revealed to be Holy's daughter, shedding tears and becoming more emotional.

characters.title: Daiya Higashikata
characters.bio: Daiya Higashikata is a secondary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. Introduced as an antagonist in the "California King Bed" story arc, Daiya becomes a neutral character in subsequent arcs.
characters.background: Daiya was born the second daughter and youngest child of Norisuke Higashikata IV and Kaato Higashikata. Around the time she was only a year old, Kaato was imprisoned for the earlier murder of a child. Due to her young age, Daiya had no memories of her mother and implicitly grew up with no knowledge of her.
characters.personality: At 16 years of age, Daiya is the youngest member of the Higashikata family's fifth generation. She appears to be fixated on an image of outward cuteness, seen through interactions like her childlike possessiveness of and offense at Josuke Higashikata's betrayal, and the playful manner of her speech. This is also reflected in her Stand, which has a toy-like appearance and abilities that sanction its use in what are essentially childish games.

characters.title: Ojiro Sasame
characters.bio: Ojiro Sasame is a recurring secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. He is introduced in the "Soft & Wet" story arc and returns during the "The Wonder of You" story arc.
characters.background: Ojiro developed a Stand in his childhood. The house where he grew up was completely leveled by the earthquake and one of the Wall Eyes rose on that spot.
characters.personality: Ojiro is a hateful man who lives a life of crime and hides his vileness beneath a friendly face.

characters.title: Joshu Higashikata
characters.bio: Joshu Higashikata is a secondary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.background: Prior to the events of JoJolion, Joshu presumably lived a normal life, being unaware of every supernatural phenomenon in Morioh. During his youth, Joshu became friends with Yasuho Hirose, with whom he eventually fell in love. Joshu applied to study Sociology in college, noted by Yasuho as ironic given his lack of social skills. He and Yasuho also kissed once.
characters.personality: Joshu is a 19-year-old college student and the third of Norisuke Higashikata IV's four children. Entitled, loud-mouthed and self-absorbed, Joshu is the archetypal spoiled teenager.

characters.title: Yasuho Hirose
characters.bio: Yasuho Hirose is a primary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.personality:
.
Yasuho is a mild-mannered and inquisitive young woman living in Morioh. She is somewhat innocent, in one instance naively following Josuke's requests to look elsewhere while he beat Ojiro during interrogation. She is more easily upset than Josuke. Despite this, she does show a level of intelligence by using Josuke's cap as a lead to discovering his past, which led to their discovery of Yoshikage Kira. She is also somewhat understanding of others, as she was able to discern, after discovering photos of bound women in Kira's home, that Josuke was not the type of person to do such a thing. She named Josuke after her dog since he resembled him.

characters.title: Tsurugi Higashikata
characters.bio: Tsurugi Higashikata is a primary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. Tsurugi cooperates with different factions as both an ally and antagonist over the course of the story.
characters.background: Tsurugi is born from the union between Jobin Higashikata and Mitsuba. As Jobin's eldest son, Tsurugi has been fated to be struck by the Rock Disease and was raised as a girl all his life. He appears to fit in quite well in the Higashikata family. He was present during the family photo and was introduced by Norisuke Higashikata IV.
characters.personality: Tsurugi's personality is a strange mix of typical childishness and precocious sinisterness.

characters.title: Massimo Volpe
characters.bio: Massimo Volpe is the main antagonist of Purple Haze Feedback, a light novel based on Vento Aureo.
characters.background: Massimo Volpe was born into a formerly wealthy family, filled with aunts and uncles with no blood relation to him due to many selling their own titles to bourgeois merchants for large sums of money. His father treated these people with deference in public, but contemptuously dismissed them as new money in private.
characters.personality: Since he was born, Volpe lives an extremely apathetic, uninspired life, often not making a big deal out of anything simply because he does not feel deeply about anything, lacking any passion. This leaves him rather close-minded and lackadaisical, but develops considerably violent mannerisms after joining Passione's Sezione Droghe.

characters.title: Sheila E.
characters.bio: Sheila E. is a primary ally featured in Purple Haze Feedback, a light novel based on Vento Aureo.
characters.personality: Sheila E. is introduced as a frank teenage girl. She doesn't chew her words and harshly criticizes Fugo for abandoning his team. Despite her indiscipline, it seems she fulfilled her role well as liaison between Passione and La Squadra Esecuzioni. Sheila E. prefers to take the most direct solution to any problem, typically destroying anything inconvenient.

characters.title: Cannolo Murolo
characters.name_ja: カンノーロ・ムーロロ
characters.bio: Cannolo Murolo is a primary ally featured in Purple Haze Feedback, a light novel based on Vento Aureo.
characters.personality: Cannolo has a dour personality, constantly grumbling against something and thinking that his teammates owe him respect because of age, although he also generally respects his superiors.
characters.ja_kanji: カンノーロ・ムーロロ

characters.title: Vittorio Cataldi
characters.name_ja: ビットリオ・カタルディ
characters.bio: Vittorio Cataldi is a secondary antagonist featured in Purple Haze Feedback, a light novel based on Vento Aureo.
characters.background: Vittorio Cataldi is a member of Passione's Sezione Droghe. After the Boss is defeated and Giorno Giovanna takes over, the team goes into hiding.
characters.personality: Vittorio is a psychotic masochist, obsessed with pain. He has a habit of cutting himself with his dagger, expressing pleasure with a loud "Gigigigigi!" while doing so. This masochism is tied to his belief that pain calls the life force inside him. In a related way, Vittorio thinks that civilized life is lacking and that it is a veneer for the emptiness of life, hence his love of pain.
characters.ja_kanji: ビットリオ・カタルディ

characters.title: Angelica Attanasio
characters.name_ja: アンジェリカ・アッタナシオ
characters.bio: Angelica Attanasio is a secondary antagonist featured in Purple Haze Feedback, a light novel based on Vento Aureo.
characters.background: Not much is known about Angelica's past prior to becoming a member of Passione aside from being a junkie. Born with a rare blood disease, Volpe used his own Stand to temporarily inhibit the disease's progression.
characters.personality: As a young "junkie girl", Angelica is an inattentive and absent-minded girl, often lost in her own thoughts due to the severe effects of the drugs produced by Sezione Droghe. To alleviate this, she takes the ones Volpe developed with Manic Depression, which temporarily inhibits the aggravation of her illness. Her abstracted behavior is notable when she seems to not have noticed Sale and Mario Zucchero, who both initially infiltrated their hideout in order to ambush their team. This also comes into advantage as behind Angelica's preoccupied thoughts, she is actually observant of others and their abilities, such when she had easily recognized Zucchero's Stand before Massimo Volpe and Vittorio
characters.ja_kanji: アンジェリカ・アッタナシオ

characters.title: Vladimir Kocaqi
characters.name_ja: ヴラディミール・コカキ
characters.bio: Vladimir Kocaqi is a primary antagonist featured in Purple Haze Feedback, a light novel based on Vento Aureo.
characters.background: Kocaqi lost his sister in while trying to escape the carnage of the. During her final breaths, Kocaqi was able to grant her everlasting peace with his newly awakened Stand, Rainy Day Dream Away. Kocaqi joined Passione at one point and became leader of the Sezione Droghe. Thanks to his powerful Stand, not even the Boss dared to cross the team.
characters.personality: Despite his profession, Vladimir Kocaqi is a gentle and wise old man, who cares for his team. Cannolo describes him as a quiet man until someone crossed him. On the other hand, he despises immoral men like Cannolo who only act for themselves. Voodoo Child demonstrates that because of his personality, he feels no guilt for anything he's done.
characters.ja_kanji: ヴラディミール・コカキ

characters.title: Dija Maker
characters.bio: Dija Maker is the main antagonist of the Escape from JoJo's Bizarre Mansion game attraction.
characters.background: When Dija Maker was a child, his friend left him behind and went home during their game of hide-and-seek. However, Dija remained hidden until dawn.
characters.personality: At first glance, Dija appears gentle and polite, but on the inside, he is actually quite sly and cunning. He takes great pride in his stand's ability to kill people without dirtying his hands.

characters.title: Masazo Kinoto
characters.bio: Masazo Kinoto is a tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "Cheap Trick" story arc.
characters.background: Kinoto is one of the people shot by Yoshihiro Kira to defend his son, Yoshikage Kira. Lacking the power to control his Stand properly, Kinoto doesn't fully develop Cheap Trick, only a phobia of showing his back to anyone else derived from its intimidating whispers. He's eventually called by Rohan to evaluate his burned house and had to turn his back against someone else's and walk backwards to reach the house.
characters.personality: Kinoto is a quiet and timid architect, but a little greedy. His Stand, Cheap Trick, constantly keeps him paranoid, subliminally warning Kinoto that he would die if anyone saw his back. Since obtaining the Stand, Kinoto is in constant danger of people seeing his back, causing him to behave erratically, and do bizarre acts to hide it, such as walking on the street with his back against somebody else's back, pushing himself against a wall to walk sideways, and even crawling up stairs upside down. As revealed by Heaven's Door, Kinoto frets over the fact he hasn't been able to find a girlfriend.

characters.title: Rohan Kishibe
characters.bio: Rohan Kishibe is a primary ally featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. He is introduced as an antagonist in the "Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House" story arc, but later becomes an ally and cooperates in the search for Yoshikage Kira. Rohan is also the protagonist of his own spin-off series, Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan.
characters.personality: Rohan Kishibe is a passionate manga artist dedicated to his work, with a particularly abrasive personality but a good heart.
characters.residence:
Rohan's House (TSKR), Morioh, Japan
Rohan's House, Morioh, Japan

characters.title: Hayato Kawajiri
characters.bio: Hayato Kawajiri is a primary ally featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, playing a crucial role in the "My Dad is Not My Dad" and "Crazy Diamond is Unbreakable" story arcs.
characters.background: Hayato was born from Kosaku and Shinobu Kawajiri in the city of Morioh, in 1987. As he lived in an apathetic household, Hayato also inherited some of this apathy for his family. At one point, Hayato developed an interest in video surveillance and began installing cameras in his parents' bedroom.
characters.personality: Hayato is described as a "creepy kid" who likes robots and spends most of his time in his bedroom. He rarely speaks to his parents, preferring to spy on them with electronic devices he has planted in their room. According to his mother, he has no close friends.

characters.title: Female Paramedic
characters.bio: This is a list of unnamed characters found in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. These characters play various roles throughout the story. Unnamed characters with enough notability are given their own articles, marked in blue. Most of the titles from earlier parts were translated from the encyclopedia found in JoJo 6251.

characters.title: Bug-Eaten
characters.bio: Bug-Eaten is a secondary antagonist featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable, specifically in the "Let's Go Hunting!" story arc.
characters.background: While Akira Otoishi had Keicho Nijimura's Arrow in his possession, he tested its powers by using it on two rats living in the farmlands surrounding Morioh. The arrow pierced the rats, granting them both the Stand Ratt. Thanks to their power, the pair of rats took dominance among the local rat population, melding their rival rodents together. They also attacked a couple of old farmers, melding their flesh together and stuffing them in the fridge for preservation. They make a nest in a drainage pipe.
characters.personality: Bug-Eaten is aggressive and cunning, being on the offensive against Jotaro and Josuke. Despite being a rat, acquiring the Stand made it confident enough to take on humans and kill to eat them as a result. It is also intelligent enough to commit basic hunting tricks and use sniping tactics like frequently switching positions or rebound its darts against obstacles to hit from blind angles.

The arrow pierced the rats, granting them both the Stand Ratt. Thanks to their power, the pair of rats took dominance among the local rat population, melding their rival rodents together.

characters.bio: Diavolo is the main antagonist of the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, as well as the fourth main antagonist of the series overall.
characters.personality: The biggest personality trait Diavolo shows is his obsession with secrecy; emphasizing the erasure of any trace of his history and keeping his identity a secret to assume his position of power as a compulsion he will fulfill by any means necessary. As he believes the mistakes of the past, or simply the past itself, are something to be defeated and destroyed for human beings to grow, he is driven anxiously about his past being a threat to him, linking it to fear, and being exceptionally apprehensive of anyone learning of him. Even in the already secretive Passione hierarchy, Diavolo goes to excessive lengths to completely hide his identity, issuing orders through several proxies or by compute

characters.title: Vinegar Doppio
characters.name_ja: ヴィネガー・ドッピオ
characters.bio: Vinegar Doppio is a primary antagonist featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo, introduced in the "My Name is Doppio" story arc.
characters.personality: Doppio is a much more regular person in contrast to Diavolo: friendly, honest, and a bit cowardly. Doppio regularly hallucinates random objects as "phones" with which he talks with his alter-ego, not knowing that they share the same body.
characters.ja_kanji: ヴィネガー・ドッピオ

characters.title: Coco Jumbo
characters.bio: Coco Jumbo is a secondary ally featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo.
characters.background: Nothing much is known about Coco Jumbo. It was discovered by either Diavolo or his gang already having its Stand ability Mr.President.
characters.personality: Despite being an animal Stand user, Coco Jumbo doesn't display any kind of personality or heightened intelligence whatsoever. It seems to, like all turtles, prefer to hide in small, dark places. Even with a conflict going on, Coco Jumbo remains indifferent to the situation, and simply keeps idling.

characters.bio: This is a list of unnamed characters found in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo. These characters play various roles throughout the story. Unnamed characters with enough notability are given their own articles, marked in blue.

characters.title: Guccio
characters.bio: Guccio is a tertiary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.background: Ever since Guccio was a child, fights always erupted around him, and his ability to irritate people followed him all the way to his time at Green Dolphin Street Prison; Guccio had received a 5 year-sentence for sexual assault and theft. Though he never engaged in any fights, the violence that occurred around him never stopped. Pucci noticed this about him, and endowed him with Survivor.
characters.personality: Though briefly shown, Guccio is a meek Stand user too afraid to confront Jolyne and the others inside the isolation ward and begs for their help when the Green Baby is born. Guccio lacks any fighting experience, and unwittingly becomes a part of Anasui's trap to attack pursuers. Though he never engaged in fights himself, Guccio somehow found himself in the isolation ward.

characters.title: Gyro Zeppeli
characters.bio: Gyro Zeppeli, born Julius Caesar Zeppeli, is one of the protagonists of the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.personality: Gyro is a cocky and flamboyant executioner marked by the harshness of life, who participates in the Steel Ball Run for the sake of Marco.

characters.title: Funny Valentine
characters.name_ja: ファニー・ヴァレンタイン
characters.bio: Funny Valentine is the main antagonist of the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, as well as the sixth main antagonist of the series overall.
characters.background: Funny Valentine was born on September 20, 1847, to unnamed parents. He is a descendant of British nobles. Through the passing of time, his family lost the land passed down from previous generations and were left humiliated. When Funny was a child, his father went to war, and never came back. One day, when he was seven years old, a soldier named Captain Valentine came to Funny's house. Captain Valentine then told the story of Funny's father. Showing a handkerchief with a date sewn on it, Valentine told Funny how his father had been captured by the enemy and was subjected to torture because the enemy wanted to learn about his company. However, Funny's father never revealed anything, because of
characters.personality: Valentine's foremost characteristics is his deeply patriotic ultranationalism for America. Marked by the gruesome fate of his father, Valentine's goal is for the United States to stand over the rest of the world. To do so, he seeks the blessing of the Saint Corpse Parts, becoming ecstatic when the Corpse blesses him. Moreover, the President shows a great degree of determination toward this goal. First acting through his subordinates early on in Steel Ball Run, Valentine later takes a greater active part in seizing the Saint's Corpse himself, confronting his enemies personally if need be, and claiming that he has no problem putting his life on the line to fulfill his objectives. He notably ma
characters.ja_kanji: ファニー・ヴァレンタイン
occupations: The 23rd President of the United States

characters.title: The Funniest Valentine
characters.name_ja: ザ・ファニエスト・ヴァレンタイン
characters.bio: The Funniest Valentine is a supporting character in the 37th universe, featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. Initially a tertiary antagonist, he later becomes an ally in the final battle.
characters.background: Five other people had been the president in between The Funniest and his grandfather, Funny Valentine. The Funniest is the current president as of 2012 in the 37th universe.
characters.personality: Similar to the original universe's Funny Valentine, The Funniest is a dignified but immoral patriot. For the sake of the United States, he acts militantly and threatens to flip Morioh and all of its citizens when the town suddenly detaches itself from Japan and becomes an island sailing west toward America.
characters.ja_kanji: ザ・ファニエスト・ヴァレンタイン

characters.title: Dr. Ferdinand
characters.name_ja: フェルディナンド博士
characters.bio: Dr. Ferdinand is a secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, specifically the "Scary Monsters" story arc.
characters.background: Dr. Ferdinand is a geologist and a paleobiologist by trade. Two years before the events of Steel Ball Run, Ferdinand obtained his Stand while searching for the Devil's Palm in Arizona. Ferdinand also entered Funny Valentine's service and learned about the Saint's Corpse.
characters.personality: Dr. Ferdinand is a geologist and a paleontologist with a very flamboyant personality. For him, the most important thing in the world is respect; he has a great respect for the planet, to the point he'd get senselessly furious should he see somebody spitting on the ground or littering. He's convinced that Earth brings prosperity only to those who respect the soil and has come to believe that dinosaurs, the once undisputed rulers of the world, died because their small brains couldn't understand this basic ideal.

characters.background: Diego Brando was born in Great Britain around 1870, as he is 20 years old by the time of the Steel Ball Run race in 1890. Diego's parents, an unnamed woman and the father, Dario, were poor and deemed they couldn't afford to raise him so they climbed a mountain and buried him alive to get rid of him. However, a storm came and the rain washed away the earth, uncovered the baby Diego. The baby found itself floating in the middle of a flooding river, passing right by his mother. She regretted her action and dove in to save Diego despite Dario's insistence that the baby was doomed anyway. Dario left them to drown and would never be seen again, but despite the odds, it turned out that Diego had su
characters.personality: During his childhood, Diego was a good-natured and resourceful kid. His mother raised him with love and taught him to keep his dignity in even the direst situation. At age five, witnessing his mother sacrificing her hands so that he could be fed, Diego developed a resentment of everyone around him for allowing that to happen, and an insatiable ambition.

characters.title: Benjamin Boomboom
characters.name_ja: ベンジャミン・ブンブーン
characters.bio: Benjamin Boomboom is a secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, introduced in the "The Desert-Born Outlaws" story arc.
characters.background: Benjamin states that when he was young, he fell from a cliff and lost his lower jaw but still walked five kilometers home. He recounts this to belittle Andre's concern about his own abdominal injury. He also says that his wife left the family and "became a whore".
characters.personality: Benjamin is ruthless and greedy, seeking to secure the race's prize money for his family by eliminating competitors. He dismisses the warnings surrounding the Devil's Palm, claiming that the powers his family acquired there brought them happiness rather than misfortune.
characters.ja_kanji: ベンジャミン・ブンブーン

characters.title: Josefumi Kujo
characters.bio: Josefumi Kujo is a primary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. Josefumi is alluded to in the "" story arc but gains real significance in the "" arc.
characters.background: Josefumi was born in 1991 to Sadafumi Kujo and Kiyomi Kujo. He was named by his grandfather who found the name Josefumi carved on a that he had found, unaware that it belonged to. As a child, Josefumi nearly drowned during an outing to the beach with his mother, being drawn underwater and striking his head on a rock, leaving him for dead. He ended up in the care of emergency room doctor Holy Joestar-Kira, who recognized Josefumi was suffering from a fatal blood clot in his brain and asked her son Yoshikage Kira to use his Stand to remove it, saving the young Josefumi's life.
characters.personality: Not much is known about Josefumi Kujo, as he had exchanged parts of his body with Kira's corpse to become Josuke Higashikata prior to the start of JoJolion. In general, Josefumi gives the impression of being an ordinary, kind young man.

characters.title: Mitsuba Higashikata
characters.bio: Mitsuba Higashikata is a secondary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. Gaining significance during the "Doctor Wu and Awaking 3 Leaves" story arc, she becomes a temporary ally to Yasuho Hirose.
characters.background: In her school days, Mitsuba was known as "Miss Cherry". She won a contest and got to travel to China and Europe for the fruit of Japan. She ended up meeting Jobin, and married into the Higashikata family. She then became a model for the Higashikata Fruit Parlor's ads. She had support from the whole family and her modeling helped with sales as well. After that, Mitsuba began to see Dr. Wu Tomoki to fix the signs of age, unknowingly being one of the guinea pigs of the Locacaca Organization which tested the effects of the Locacaca-derived medicine on her.
characters.personality: Mitsuba is a vain woman, caring a lot about her appearance and wanting to look perfect. She's the type to keep secrets, repeatedly visiting Dr. Wu Tomoki to have various operations to maintain her good looks (for instance having a breast enlargement operation), paying large sums of money behind Jobin's back. She has no financial sense, spending money as soon as she has it.

characters.title: Dolomite
characters.bio: Dolomite, formerly known as Masaji Dorokoma, is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "Dolomite's Blue Lagoon" story arc.
characters.background: Years ago, Dolomite originally was a normal-looking Rock Human that loved an unknown woman fondly. The woman, apparently blind, wandered into a power plant and Dolomite rushed after her. He pushed her out of the way in time, saving her. However, the power pylons electrically shocked him to such a severe degree that it blasted apart his arms, legs and teeth. The last thing Dolomite saw was the woman wandering away. Over the years Dolomite ate several animals, causing the police to search for him.
characters.personality: Little is known of Dolomite's past personality. In the past, Dolomite was an easy-going man. His idea of paradise was inspired by the novel, referring to a tropical paradise isolated from the rest of the world. At that time, he also cared for another woman. In fact, he saved her from electrocution at the cost of his own body. Dolomite still harbors some feelings for her and expressed a desire to seek her out and invite her to the "Blue Lagoon".

characters.title: Urban Guerrilla
characters.bio: Urban Guerrilla, otherwise known as Ryo Shimosato, is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "" story arc.
characters.background: Urban Guerrilla is a Rock Human who worked for the Locacaca Organization. In addition, he was working as a doctor in TG University Hospital specialized in gastrointestinal diseases and pretended to be "Ryo Shimosato, aged 38".
characters.personality: Urban Guerrilla is an animalistic Rock Human, grunting and growling while speaking. When stalking his targets, he devises a "killing order" to select who he'll assassinate first based on their threat level. Urban Guerrilla also displays an intense and disturbing side when frustrated, stating to Rai Mamezuku that he'd take his time dismembering and mutilating Mamezuku's body. Despite his brutality, Urban Guerrilla is efficient in his work and intelligent; observing his enemies before attacking and making sure to take needed precautions.

characters.title: Wu Tomoki
characters.bio: Wu Tomoki, also known as Doctor Wu, is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically in the "Doctor Wu and Awaking 3 Leaves" story arc.
characters.background: Wu Tomoki graduated from TG University's medical department and passed the national exam for medical practitioners before working at their hospital as a professional physician. He was unmarried and there were no records of him having any unpaid taxes.
characters.personality: At first glance, Wu appears to be polite and calm while working with patients. He is shown to temporarily derail conversations in order to indulge in an eccentric eating habit, which includes consuming excessive amounts of and water in short bursts. That being said, he seems to typically ask for permission from his patient before snacking.

characters.title: Rai Mamezuku
characters.bio: Rai Mamezuku is a primary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.background: Mamezuku was born into a family of fruit farmers, whose high-class pears were prized goods.
characters.personality: Rai Mamezuku is an eccentric and brusque individual with little care for politeness. He is highly analytical and quick-witted in his way of approaching problems. As soon as he learns of what is happening in Morioh and that he is under attack, he takes the initiative in joining with his allies. With a single phone call with Norisuke about Josuke's confusing issue, Mamezuku manages to grasp the stakes for every party involved and see the best course of action for him. He tends to carefully observe his surroundings and verbally takes notes of everything remotely interesting to him; this habit allows him to discern the nature and subtleties of the attack against him. characters.residence: Summer Home, Mount Hananero, Morioh, Japan

characters.title: Aisho Dainenjiyama
characters.bio: Aisho Dainenjiyama is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, most notably in the "Doobie Wah" story arc.
characters.background: Aisho was originally born as a nameless Rock Human. At some point in the past, Aisho acquired his identity as "Aisho Dainenjiyama," and started working as a security guard at Morioh's baseball stadium. At the same time, he was employed as a dealer for the Locacaca Organization.
characters.personality: Despite his initial stoic facade, Aisho is a paranoid man who easily gets nervous most of the time. He tends to overreact and notice small things, such as when a group of birds in the park all stared at his direction. He can be frightened and intimidated by unseen enemies. However, this paranoia served useful to him, especially when he deduced that there were two people tailing him, Yasuho Hirose and Tsurugi Higashikata, and that they were also Stand users. He would also briefly experience sudden flashbacks to previous traumatic experiences. characters.title: Yotsuyu Yagiyama
characters.bio: Yotsuyu Yagiyama is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. He is shown at the end of the Paper Moon Deception story arc and fully introduced in the "Norisuke Higashikata, Tsurugi Higashikata, and Yotsuyu Yagiyama" story arc.
characters.background: Yotsuyu was born a nameless Rock Human. Although his youth is undisclosed, he managed to steal the identity of a young man named "Yotsuyu Yagiyama" and become an architect. He is said to have been one of Jobin Higashikata's friends in college. Yotsuyu was hired to build the Higashikata Residence for Norisuke in 2010, as well as the Higashikata Fruit Parlor's parlor and the renovated Morioh Stadium. At the same time, he worked as Tamaki Damo's underling in the Locacaca Organization. At one point, Yotsuyu approached Jobin Higashikata to enlist him in the organization.
characters.personality: Yotsuyu states that above all he desires social status and at one point even declares his intention to steal Norisuke Higashikata IV's fortune.

characters.title: Norisuke Higashikata IV
characters.bio: Norisuke Higashikata IV, born Josuke Higashikata, is a primary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.background: Norisuke was affected by the Rock Disease at the age of eleven in winter 1963. As part of a superstition practiced by the Higashikata family, Norisuke dressed up as a girl in order to alleviate the illness. His mother Tomoko eventually saved him from the disease by taking his place through equivalent exchange.
characters.personality: Norisuke first gives the impression of being a laid-back and happy old man. He greets Josuke with a smile and then en route to his house, describes himself as a "yanki", a subculture of delinquency that was popular in the 80's and 90's in Japan, before laughing openly in the presence of Josuke and Yasuho. He maintains an ability to joke. During quiet moments, Norisuke consistently demonstrates a genial and enthusiastic side to him, for instance, proudly showing his fruit shop to Josuke or happily performing morning exercises.

characters.title: Karera Sakunami
characters.bio: Karera Sakunami is a tertiary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "Love Love Deluxe" story arc.
characters.background: Not much is known about Karera's youth. It is known that Karera is not keeping contact with her family and is uninterested in doing so, meaning she may have had some bad history with them.
characters.personality: Karera is a temperamental, cunning, and crude woman who tends to pick fights with anyone in case she can benefit from them, irritating whoever she speaks to. She generally acts carefree and unpredictably. Although she is usually energetic and playful, she is prone to suddenly changing the subject and her mood. She is quite clingy and flirty with Josuke, whom she mistakes for being her crush, Josefumi. As soon as Josuke meets her, he can tell that she is the type of woman he would never love.

characters.title: Milagroman's User
characters.bio: This is a list of unnamed characters found in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. These characters play various roles throughout the story. Unnamed characters with enough notability are given their own articles, marked in blue.

characters.title: Zaihei Nigatake
characters.bio: Zaihei Nigatake is a tertiary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.background: Two years prior to the events of JoJolion, Zaihei Nigatake attended a concert in Hamburg, Germany. After the concert, he didn't have any money to afford a taxi back to his hotel, so on impulse he swiped a bill from a homeless man. Little did he know, however, that bill was one of the Milagroman's bills, and the man he stole from was pretending to be homeless.
characters.personality: Not much is known of Zaihei's personality. However, he becomes overjoyed at being lifted from the Milagroman's curse after suffering from it for two years. He is a fan of Rena Nanami, as he set his PIN number to be based on her name, and photos and posters of her can be seen all over his apartment room. He also doesn't seem to be an organized person, as his room is somewhat messy.

characters.title: Poor Tom
characters.bio: Poor Tom is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically in the "Ozon Baby's Pressure" story arc.
characters.background: Poor Tom is a Rock Human, but his youth is unknown. At one point, he integrated an organization of fellow Rock Humans and became Urban Guerrilla and Doremifasolati Do's handler. In addition, Poor Tom was working at the TG University Hospital as a doctor in obstetrics, specializing in infertility treatment.
characters.personality: Belying his appearance, Tom has a rather vulgar personality. He claims to have a girlfriend and still eyes other women, using his size to look under their skirts. He also speaks in a familiar tone. Poor Tom smokes as well.

characters.name_ja: エイ・フェックス兄弟
characters.bio: The A. Phex Brothers are secondary antagonists featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "Love Love Deluxe" story arc.
characters.background: The A. Phex Brothers were born as nameless Rock Humans, and subsequently took their names from normal humans. At one point in their lives, they became assassins for the Locacaca Organization.
characters.personality: The pair share a duality described as harmonious with one another, being based on the Japanese concept of 'A-un', which explains the connected nature of opposites and their seemingly contradictory similarities.
characters.ja_kanji: エイ・フェックス兄弟

characters.title: Kaato Higashikata
characters.bio: Kaato Higashikata is a secondary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.background: Fifteen years ago, Kaato Higashikata was a loving housewife to Norisuke Higashikata IV and her family. Sharing an especially close connection with her son, Jobin, she'd take special care to make sure he was safe as a child, due to his developing Rock Disease. Unbeknownst to her, Jobin was secretly being bullied by his fellow boy scouts; one of whom forced Jobin to steal Kaato's underwear and take candid photos of her in the shower. Discovering Jobin's bully situation, Kaato approached her son after he awakened his new Stand. She had Jobin accompany her as she stored the bully's unconscious body in her car's trunk.
characters.personality: Kaato is a very mysterious individual, showing different sides of herself depending on who she's speaking to. She seems to act the most genuine around her son, Jobin Higashikata, with whom she has a special connection. Since he was a boy, Kaato doted on Jobin and would take special care to make sure he was always alright. Her affection for him does not seem to have diminished over the years, as she is still happy to dote on him even when he's an adult. She notably smiles as she sets Jobin's cuffs for him.

characters.title: Jobin Higashikata
characters.bio: Jobin Higashikata is a primary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.
characters.background: It is known from his son Tsurugi's explanation of the Higashikata family's superstitious beliefs of warding away "demons of sickness" that Jobin, being the firstborn son of his family, was raised as a girl until he turned twelve.
characters.personality: When he was a child, Jobin Higashikata was very meek and withdrawn. Melancholic due to his illness, Jobin quietly bore with the bullying one of his seniors in his scouting movement put him through, not daring to stand up for himself. However, it is shown Jobin had the courage to refuse the bully's order to burn down someone else's home.

characters.title: Johnny Joestar
characters.name_ja: ジョニィ・ジョースター
characters.bio: Johnny Joestar, born Jonathan Joestar, is one of the protagonists of the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, and the seventh JoJo of the series. He also appears in flashbacks in the eighth part, JoJolion.
characters.personality: Johnny Joestar is introduced as a distant, depressive paraplegic man whose career as a horse jockey was ruined when he was shot in the spine after conceitedly antagonizing a passerby. However, after he momentarily experiences the ability to stand on his feet after touching the Steel Balls of Gyro Zeppeli, he becomes determined to follow Gyro and, through his guidance, learn the Spin for himself. Later, having his legs twitch due to the Corpse Parts, he additionally sets out to acquire them, despite the many other murderous pursuers of the same goal.
characters.ja_kanji: ジョニィ・ジョースター

characters.title: Tamaki Damo
characters.bio: Tamaki Damo is a primary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, and introduced in the "Hato Brought Her Boyfriend Home" story arc.
characters.background:
Damo was born as a nameless Rock Human, and subsequently stole the name "Tamaki Damo" from some hapless human. He subsequently set shop at a cleaning shop named "Damokan Cleaning". At the same time, he led his men in the Locacaca Organization, using it to sell the Locacaca to a handful of wealthy people for a hefty price.

On August 19, 2011, Tamaki Damo and his accomplice Yotsuyu Yagiyama stow aboard Yoshikage Kira's ship and ambush both him and Josefumi Kujo. Kira attempts to stop Damo with his Killer Queen, but Vitamin C softens Kira, Josefumi and their Stands. Damo reveals that he's aware of the duo's plan to steal and graft Locacaca Branches to grow their own fruits. He informs Kira t
characters.personality: Damo is introduced as an awkward but polite individual when he meets the Higashikata family, notably mumbling while speaking to Norisuke IV and Joshu, insisting on sitting on the guest's seat even if he breaks it, and somehow ignoring when his combover is messed up with. This is later revealed to be a facade hiding a much colder and calculated personality, which he unveils while interrogating Norisuke.

characters.title: Hato Higashikata
characters.bio: Hato Higashikata is a secondary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. Introduced early in the story, she gains significance in the "Hato Brought Her Boyfriend Home" story arc and assists Josuke as an ally in the successive “” story arc.
characters.background: Before the events of JoJolion, Hato and Jobin were the only two siblings old enough to know their mother, Kaato Higashikata. Hato was nine years old at the time Kaato disappeared, and their dad, Norisuke Higashikata IV, would tell them things like their mother left or she died. However, Hato checked up on the facts herself and discovered her mother was in prison for 15 years due to murdering a child.
characters.personality:
One of Hato's most obvious traits is that she is somewhat ignorant. For instance, she confesses that she thought that Hawaii was actually part of Japan because the place names were written in kanji, forgetting to obtain a visa and ruining the family vacation. According to Kaato, Hato would also always misread the kanji for 'person' as 'enter' when she was younger. often argue with each other
Hato is also proud of her beauty and is shown to be serious about her work. In preparation for a collaboration with the famous ice-skater, she is shown taking great care in appearing proper but also worries that she could overshadow Arakawa with her beauty.

characters.title: Toru
characters.bio: Toru is the main antagonist of the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, as well as the seventh main antagonist of the series overall.
characters.background: Toru, like other Rock Humans, was abandoned by his mother as a newborn and left in the wilderness. Shortly afterward, he infiltrated a hornet nest to continue his physical development. Approximately 17 years later, he rapidly matured into his adult body, killing the hornet colony in the process. He made up his own name, as with other Rock Humans. His last name is unknown, if he indeed has one, and it is unknown if he stole his own identity from a human being or not. He then traveled to Morioh, and entered society undetected.
characters.personality: Toru is a callous and mysterious individual who directs the Locacaca Organization from the shadows. He uses a friendly charade as a means to disguise himself and drive away suspicion.

characters.title: Ningbo
characters.bio: Ningbo is a secondary antagonist featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands, specifically the "" story arc.
characters.background: Ningbo is a firefighter hired by Hacca Howler to work for HOWLER Company, though Howler doesn't remember him. He was friends with Bobby Jean and investigated his murder at Pearl General Hospital together with Key West and Laem Chabang.
characters.personality: Ningbo is a quiet and stoic individual whose intense gaze makes him naturally intimidating, especially during interrogations. As a man of few words, Ningbo never once says his Stand name out loud, which is a trait that Paco Laburantes picks up on and taunts him about. Meryl Mei Qi assesses him to be quite crazy and someone who cares more about money than loyalty. However, she believes that Ningbo is vindictive and won't accept her bribe of sharing Howler's 50 billion dollars since he wants to avenge Bobby Jean. He shows his conviction by fighting relentlessly, refusing to back down even after receiving a nearly fatal beatdown from Paco.

characters.bio: Lulu is a secondary antagonist featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands, specifically the "" and "" story arcs.
characters.background: Lulu was abandoned by her mother, who went to live with someone else. Instead, she was raised by Hacca Howler and the HOWLER Company. She believes that Hacca is her father, but he didn't tell her directly, and refuses to talk to her about it.
characters.personality: Lulu has a playful and childlike demeanor, while also being very demanding, manipulative, and bossy. She shows enthusiastic expressions and persistently pleads for Bobby Jean to buy anything she finds cute, such as a "Hula NYAN Dancer" figure or a flower hair ornament that Dragona left behind. When begging for something, she acts extremely insistent, akin to a child having a temper tantrum. For example, while demanding for Bobby to buy her the flower ornament, she repeatedly scratches the vehicle in front of her using her hula figure. characters.title: Charming Man
characters.bio: Charming Man is a primary ally featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.personality: Charming Man is an energetic and caring elder brother, yet also demanding and aggressive. He is athletic and enjoys participating in recreational activities such as bicycle races and 2-mile swimming marathons with his younger brother. He looks forward to those events with excitement and has a competitive spirit. He gains an interest in the Lava Rock after his younger brother falls into a where the Lava Rock came from. However, he doesn't desire it for money since he thinks that it's impossible to become rich using it. Rather, he thinks using it would help him find his younger brother.

characters.bio: Wild Cat Size is a group of secondary antagonists featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands, specifically the "" story arc.
characters.background: Wild Cat Size is a trio of cats belonging to a unique species native to the island of Hawaii. At some point, Charming Man tamed them. The cats found Lava Rock fragments on the slopes of Hualalai and played with them by rolling them around. Rohan Kishibe was on an illegal hike there to collect natural ingredients for making art supplies when he noticed the cats and coincidentally discovered that the dollar bills he had dropped were attracted to two Lava Rocks. After Rohan retrieved the Lava Rocks, Charming Man had Wild Cat Size spy on Rohan, and they entered his villa.
characters.personality: Not much is known about Wild Cat Size, but Rohan considers a stray cat coming to his villa unnatural. They wander around the mansion, attacking the gang attempting to steal from Rohan.

characters.title: Hacca Howler
characters.bio: Hacca Howler is the current main antagonist of the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands.
characters.background: When Hacca was a child, there was a sudden change in his family's flow of money due to the Lava Rock's involvement. One day, Hacca's grandfather called the boy to his side to watch TV with him. He showed Hacca a deed of their land, which he took the opportunity to make to have a legal basis on the ownership of the farmland. Moreover, the grandfather showed Hacca the treasure chest in which the family had been keeping precious heirlooms and explained that the heirlooms could be sold off if he's ever in a pinch because they would always return thanks to the pieces of the Lava Rock stored inside next to the items.

He takes pride in his family's legacy, refusing to surrender the land on the Hualalai north slope he inherited from his ancestor. He favors top-quality goods, knowing which areas of produce the best and claiming he rides only in with the starlight headliner when being picked up or dropped off from airports. Money was also missing from her classmates' envelopes. Laem Chabang realized that her teacher was the one stealing the money, but she got blamed for it instead. She tried telling others, but nobody believed her.

characters.title: Mundra
characters.bio: Mundra is a secondary antagonist featured in the ninth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, The JOJOLands, specifically the "" story arc.
characters.background: Mundra possesses a Stand that he claims allows him to hear the voices of dead spirits. The spirits repeatedly discussed the fortune of a wealthy elderly woman who lived alone, eventually tempting Mundra to poison her for the money. He was convicted of the murder and sentenced to life imprisonment.
characters.personality: Mundra is greedy and easily swayed by the prospect of wealth. Although he claims that he had not originally intended to murder the wealthy elderly woman, repeatedly hearing the dead discuss her fortune eventually tempted him to poison her for the money. His explanation suggests weak restraint and a tendency to rationalize his own wrongdoing after acting on selfish impulses.

characters.name_ja: エイ・フェックス兄弟
characters.bio: The A. Phex Brothers are secondary antagonists featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "Love Love Deluxe" story arc.
characters.background: The A. Phex Brothers were born as nameless Rock Humans, and subsequently took their names from normal humans. At one point in their lives, they became assassins for the Locacaca Organization.
characters.personality: The pair share a duality described as harmonious with one another, being based on the Japanese concept of 'A-un', which explains the connected nature of opposites and their seemingly contradictory similarities.

characters.title: Chaka
characters.bio: Chaka is a tertiary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders.
characters.personality: In his brief appearance, Chaka is a belittled meek farmhand. When he unsheathes Anubis his demeanour and expression morph into a cold-blooded killer. He is manipulated by Anubis into battling the Joestar Group. Though an amateur swordsman in reality, the blade fuels his hubris. Polnareff in-particular compliments Chaka for confronting him directly.

characters.title: Khan
characters.bio: Khan is a tertiary antagonist featured in the third part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stardust Crusaders.
characters.personality: Khan is an affable barber, often seen with a smile. He gladly listens to his customer's requests and apologizes for any mistakes. Not much else is known about him since he unsheathes Anubis for an unknown reason not long into Polnareff's shave.

characters.title: Thunder McQueen
characters.name_ja: サンダー・マックイイーン
characters.bio: Thunder McQueen is a secondary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, specifically the "Ermes's Stickers" story arc.
characters.background: At one point, a girl promised McQueen that she would be his friend but then moved away, depressing him.
characters.personality: McQueen is an exceptionally depressed and suicidal inmate at Green Dolphin Street Prison.
characters.ja_kanji: サンダー・マックイイーン

characters.title: Sports Maxx
characters.bio: Sports Maxx is a primary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, specifically the "Kiss of Love and Revenge" story arc.
characters.background: Sports Maxx is a car dealer by profession but is in fact a vicious member of the mafia in Florida, having committed over forty counts of various crimes. He is first shown curb stomping a man to death outside Gloria Costello's restaurant, only to have been witnessed committing the act by Ermes fleeing the scene. Instead of pursuing Ermes, his attention would shift to her sister who put herself in danger calling the police on Maxx to protect Ermes. In retaliation, he proceeded to have Gloria strangled to death before dumping her body into a gutter, escaping the police who needed a testimony. Shortly after, Maxx is arrested but is only found guilty of tax evasion and extortion, for which he is
characters.personality: Sports Maxx has displayed the behavior of a violent gang member prior to entering Green Dolphin Street Prison. When Foo Fighters mentions Ermes's story, she says that Sports Maxx killed someone by making the victim put a wooden stick in their mouth before violently stomping on them. He then had Gloria Costello killed for denouncing him to the police. Maxx has no guilt at all for what he did, blaming Gloria for sticking her nose in his "business" instead of admitting any wrong.

characters.title: Miraschon
characters.bio: Miraschon is a secondary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, specifically the "Marilyn Manson, The Debt Collector" story arc.
characters.background: Miraschon was sentenced to Green Dolphin Street Prison for 5 years after committing theft and armed robbery.
characters.personality:
Brothers, Miraschon has a habit of saying "Good!"
Miraschon is described as being a compulsive liar who enjoys stealing and gambling.

characters.title: Viviano Westwood
characters.name_ja: ヴィヴァーノ・ウエストウッド
characters.bio: Viviano Westwood is a secondary antagonist featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean, specifically the "The Secret of Guard Westwood" story arc.
characters.background: Westwood is a guard that worked at the Green Dolphin Street Prison for three years, after working in a Miami customs house prior. Enrico Pucci gave him a Stand at an undisclosed time, although it is said that it was either an hour or the day before he attacks Jolyne Cujoh.
characters.personality: Ordinarily, Viviano Westwood is a regular prison guard at Green Dolphin Street Prison. He has fun antagonizing convicts, and is friendly with his colleague Sonny Likir, even making bets with him. He believes prisoners are the scum of society and hates them, confessing to being irritated in their presence and that being treated "like shit" by the likes of them infuriates him.
characters.ja_kanji: ヴィヴァーノ・ウエストウッド

characters.title: Mountain Lodge Owner
characters.bio: The unnamed Mountain Lodge Owner is a tertiary character featured in the sixth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Stone Ocean.
characters.background: Ever since he was young, anyone who came near him frequently got into fights. His parents got into a fight that almost killed both of them in which they got divorced. His siblings all live separately from each other. At a later point, he had set up a mountain lodge in the region of.
characters.personality: Little is known about the man's personality, as he's only mentioned. However, he becomes angry when a woman insults him for having foul body odor, to the point where his Stand, Survivor, is activated.

characters.title: Boomboom Family
characters.bio: The Boomboom Family is a family of secondary antagonists featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run.
characters.background: According to Benjamin, the family acquired their abilities while prospecting for a mine in a desert mountain avoided by the local Indigenous people. Although the area was said to bring misfortune, Benjamin believes that their powers made the family happy. Mountain Tim later identifies the area as a Devil's Palm.

characters.title: Andre Boomboom
characters.name_ja: アンドレ・ブンブーン
characters.bio: Andre Boomboom is a secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, introduced in the "The Desert-Born Outlaws" story arc.
characters.background: According to Benjamin, the family acquired Tomb of the Boom 1 2 3 while prospecting for a mine in a desert mountain avoided by the local Indigenous people. Mountain Tim later identifies this area as a Devil's Palm. Benjamin says that the mother of Andre and L.A left the family and "became a whore".
characters.personality: Andre shares his family's greed and willingness to murder competitors to secure the race's prize money. He is boastful, showing off his nose and ear tricks to L.A. while refusing to explain them, and confidently declaring that Gyro's Steel Ball cannot reach him.
characters.ja_kanji: アンドレ・ブンブーン

characters.title: L.A. Boomboom
characters.bio: L.A. Boomboom is a secondary antagonist featured in the seventh part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Steel Ball Run, introduced in the "The Desert-Born Outlaws" story arc.
characters.background: According to Benjamin, the family acquired Tomb of the Boom 1 2 3 while prospecting for a mine in a desert mountain avoided by the local Indigenous people. Mountain Tim later identifies this area as a Devil's Palm. Benjamin says that the mother of Andre and L.A left the family and "became a whore".
characters.personality: L.A. is childish, naive, and prone to emotional outbursts. He struggles with basic arithmetic, asking his family to calculate the combined prize money for finishing in the first three places. He also believes Andre's claim that their mother was a stork and wonders if he looks like one.

characters.title: Dixie Flatline
characters.bio: This is a list of minor characters found in various spin-offs of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure.
